多智能体系统

[MA-0] Capability Composition in Heterogeneous Teams via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling

【速读】：该论文旨在解决异构团队在缺乏协作示范数据的情况下，如何生成符合物理约束的协同任务轨迹问题。由于真实协作示范成本高昂且难以获取，尤其对于未曾执行过的任务，传统基于示范学习的生成模型无法直接应用。其解决方案的关键在于：将团队协同的物理条件（如空间可达性、动作兼容性等）建模为对团队轨迹的显式约束，并在仅使用单个智能体独立示范训练的生成模型采样过程中强制施加这些约束。通过理论证明，该方法可生成所有满足约束的团队轨迹，而无需依赖任何协作示范；其中，约束决定了可生成轨迹的可行性，示范数据则决定其概率分布。数值实验和多机器人平台实证表明，该方法能高效生成符合约束的协同轨迹，且支持动态成员变更而无需重新训练，显著提升了生成式协同规划的灵活性与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23149
作者: Diana Laura Morales,Ruoyu Lin,Magnus Egerstedt,Fabio Pasqualetti
机构: University of California, Irvine (加州大学欧文分校); University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The agents in a heterogeneous team can cooperate to accomplish tasks that exceed their individual capabilities. The team trajectories for a cooperative task can be generated by a generative model, provided that the model has been trained on demonstrations of the agents cooperating. Yet, demonstrations of cooperation are costly and may not exist for tasks that the team has never performed. The conditions under which the agents can combine their capabilities, however, are physical properties of the team and are known before any demonstration is collected. We encode the conditions as constraints on the team trajectories, and we enforce the constraints while sampling from generative models trained on demonstrations of each agent alone. We prove that the proposed method can generate every team trajectory that satisfies the constraints, although the demonstrations contain no cooperation. Hence the constraints determine which team trajectories can be generated, and the demonstrations determine how likely each team trajectory is. Numerical results on two cooperative tasks show the effectiveness of the method, which generates cooperative team trajectories that satisfy the constraints and requires no retraining when agents join or leave the team. Finally, we implement the method on a multi-robot testbed.

[MA-1] Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自改进型编码代理（self-improving coding agent）在任务执行过程中缺乏对行为过程的可控性问题，尤其在开放性任务中，传统指令难以有效引导其行为模式与产出质量。其核心挑战在于：如何通过设计可持久化的价值导向机制，使代理不仅提升性能，还能生成符合特定价值观的解决方案。解决方案的关键在于引入基于舒瓦茨基本人类价值理论（Schwartz’s theory of basic human values）的短期价值声明，并将其嵌入代理的持久指令文件中，以系统性地影响其自我改进路径。研究发现，不同价值类型显著影响代理的表现与产出特征：开放性价值（openness to change）可提升模型在未见数据上的性能，而保守性价值（conservation）则导致表现劣于无价值设定的情况；同时，价值取向直接影响生成算法的规模、复杂度和实现策略。此外，尽管代理自主修订自身价值会削弱价值间的差异，且从AI文献中提炼的价值未能带来可观测优势，但经过人工精心设计的价值仍能有效塑造代理的构建行为与性能表现，表明人类监督在价值设计中的不可替代性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23067
作者: Jason Liang,Dylan Waldner,Risto Miikkulainen
机构: Cognizant AI Lab(认知智能实验室)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent’s persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz’s theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.

[MA-2] Rag HarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agent ic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在使用检索增强生成（RAG）系统时，因缺乏可解释性与可审计性而导致的“修复失效”问题：即系统虽能自主进行证据补充、策略测试与修复决策，但其修复过程难以验证有效性，传统指标如准确率可能掩盖深层错误。其核心挑战在于如何有效识别并调试修复路径中的失败模式，尤其是在高复杂度合同文本（如非披露协议）中，系统未能完成应有修复却未被察觉。解决方案的关键是提出 RagHarnessDebugger 框架，通过基于 Jev（Justification Evidence Validation）引导的可追踪执行流水线，完整记录每一次修复决策，并构建审计层以验证每条修复轨迹的完整性、验证逻辑的匹配性以及接受规则的可达性。该框架结合反事实重放（counterfactual replay）与标注错误分析，实现对修复路径的端到端回溯，揭示了开发集与复现集中分别高达77%和76%的可用但未被实际执行的修复机会。实验表明，经调试优化后的系统在开发集与复现集上分别提升准确率3.6与3.7个百分点，并显著改善全合同访问基准得分。本研究的核心价值不仅在于定位修复失败的根本原因，更在于为 RAG 系统提供可解释的判断透明性机制，支持持续迭代与决策可解释性建设。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22991
作者: Moriya Dechtiar,Daniel Martin Katz,Michael J. Bommarito II,Hongming Wang,Sylvain Jaume
机构: Illinois Tech - Chicago Kent College of Law, USA; CLTDS, Bucerius Law School, Germany; Yong Pung How School of Law, Singapore Management University; CodeX - The Stanford Center for Legal Informatics, Stanford University; Bommarito Consulting, LLC; Harvard University, USA; Massachusetts Institute of Technology, USA
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system’s repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger’s audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of repairs vs regressions and policy acceptance gap of 77% and 76% of available but unrealised repairs on development and replication sets. Our audit, together with a labeled error analysis and replay mechanism, allowed following the execution path all the way to the terminal decision - uncovering where missing repairs became lost. Our revised harness improved accuracy over the initial BM25-only baseline by 3.6 points on development contracts and 3.7 points on the replication set, and even improved our full contract access reference score by 1.1 on development and 2.4 on replication set. While our work here demonstrates how the debugger can conduct decision root-cause analysis for missed repairs, the true value lies with providing this debugger for judgment visibility serving continuous improvement of RAG decisions and their explainability. Keywords: agentic RAG, AI evidence repair, harness explainability, counterfactual replay, Jev, ContractNLI Subjects: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Software Engineering (cs.SE) Cite as: arXiv:2611.22991 [cs.AI] (or arXiv:2611.22991v1 [cs.AI] for this version) https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2611.22991 Focus to learn more arXiv-issued DOI via DataCite (pending registration)

[MA-3] Virtual Double Oracle: Faster Convergence by Leverag ing Strategies That Were Watching All Along NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决双人零和博弈中近似纳什均衡求解时，传统在线双奥多尔（Online Double Oracle, ODO）等方法在策略种群扩展过程中因重初始化导致的效率损失问题。其核心挑战在于：每次新增策略时，基于乘法权重更新（Multiplicative Weights Update, MWU）的方法将新策略重新初始化为均匀先验，从而抹去其历史表现信息，造成学习过程中的“遗忘”与低效探索。本文提出虚拟双奥多尔（Virtual Double Oracle, VDO），其关键创新在于利用一个双线性恒等式——即某策略的完整事后损失历史可坍缩为其对对手时间平均策略的期望收益——实现对新策略的最优初始权重设定，使其从诞生之初即具备合理的权重分配。该设计使VDO在策略种群规模为 kkk 时达到 O(k/T)O(\sqrt{k}/T)O(k​/T) 的可剥削性收敛率，优于原有方法。进一步地，折扣型虚拟双奥多尔（Discounted VDO, dVDO）通过引入衰减因子调节历史偏好，缓解重初始化带来的过度集中问题。实验结果表明，在矩阵博弈、扑克及Goofspiel等场景中，适当调整折扣参数的dVDO显著降低了有限时域下的可剥削性，并提升了所发现策略种群的质量。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22806
作者: Ruilan Wang,Francisco Aristi Reina,Katerina Papadaki
机构: London School of Economics (伦敦政治经济学院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 25 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Double Oracle (DO) and PSRO approximate Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum games by iteratively expanding a strategy population with best responses supplied by an oracle. Online Double Oracle (ODO) interleaves multiplicative weights updates (MWU) with population discovery and obtains an O(\sqrtk\ln k/T) rate, where T is the number of learning rounds and k is the larger of the two players’ final population sizes. We identify the reinitialisation step as an underexplored design choice: at each expansion, MWU-based methods reset newly discovered strategies to a uniform prior. We introduce Virtual Double Oracle (VDO), which exploits a bilinear identity (a strategy’s full hindsight loss history collapses to its utility against the time-averaged opponent) to initialise each new strategy with the MWU weight it would have had from the start. We prove that VDO achieves O(\sqrtk/T) exploitability over the discovered population as it grows, provided the cumulative cost of adding strategies is at most linear in k , a condition supported by our empirical measurements. Discounted VDO (dVDO) moderates historical preferences to reduce over-concentration at reinitialisation. Experiments across matrix games, poker, and Goofspiel show that, with a suitable discount, dVDO can substantially reduce finite-horizon exploitability relative to both VDO and uniform-reset ODO, and can improve the discovered strategy populations.

[MA-4] Guarded Swarms in the Loop: A ROS 2/PX4 Digital Twin for Hybrid Digital-Analog Coordination of UAV/UGV Swarms

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在对抗性环境中运行的无人飞行器与地面车辆集群（UAV/UGV）因过度依赖软件栈而面临物理安全风险的问题。传统软件系统易受攻击，其通信网络构成潜在攻击面，难以保障任务执行过程中的本质安全。为此，论文提出“受保护集群”（Guarded Swarms）架构，其核心创新在于将数字协同层与独立的模拟安全层相结合：数字协同层基于基于话题的通信空间佩特里网（Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Nets, TB-CSPN），实现多模态感知、人工授权到车辆任务分配的逻辑链路；而模拟安全层则以每辆车的虚拟安全板（Virtual Safety Board）形式存在，作为独立于协同层的硬件抽象层，可对执行指令进行强制否决。解决方案的关键在于通过数字孪生系统在ROS 2、PX4飞控软件在环仿真（SITL）与Gazebo仿真环境下，首次实现了该架构的可执行实例化，并验证了其三个关键负向保证（即：无冲突证据驱动的任务、无时间不一致证据的任务、无未授权证据的任务）在60次反事实测试中均成立；同时证明威胁确认范围受限于最窄感知模态，且安全层能独立于协同层完全发挥其防护能力。在故障注入实验中，当安全门由独立机制控制时，可有效防止所有由伪造任务或被攻陷工作节点引发的碰撞事件，而若否决权仍由受损节点持有，则无法实现任何防护。此外，该数字孪生系统揭示了原架构规范未覆盖的实现级隐患，并明确划定了仿真可验证属性与必须通过硬件实测才能确认的属性之间的界限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22773
作者: Uwe M. Borghoff,Paolo Bottoni,Luca D’Aurizio,Remo Pareschi
机构: University of the Bundeswehr Munich (慕尼黑联邦国防军大学); Sapienza University of Rome (罗马第一大学); University of Molise (莫利塞大学)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 10 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Submitted to ICMCIS 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Swarms of unmanned aerial and ground vehicles (UAV/UGV) operating in contested environments cannot rely on software alone for physical safety, since the software stack and its networks are part of the attack surface. The Guarded Swarms architecture addresses this by pairing a digital coordination layer, built on Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Nets (TB-CSPN), with an independent analog safety layer that can veto unsafe actuation commands. So far, the architecture has been specified and argued for, but not executed. We present the first executable instantiation of Guarded Swarms as a digital twin built on ROS 2, the PX4 autopilot in software-in-the-loop mode, and Gazebo, with two UAVs and one UGV in a coastal counter-UAS scenario. The TB-CSPN transition chain, from multi-modal sensing through human authorization to vehicle tasking, is mapped one-to-one onto ROS 2 nodes, and the analog layer is modeled as a per-vehicle Virtual Safety Board that gates every command. Eight groups of experiments show that the three negative guarantees of the architecture (no mission from conflicting, temporally incoherent, or unauthorized evidence) hold at three distinct stages of the chain in all 60 counterfactual runs; that threat confirmation is bounded by the narrowest sensing modality; that the safety layer exercises its full modeled envelope independently of the coordination layer; and, under fault injection, that it prevents every collision caused by a forged mission or a compromised worker once its veto is enforced by an independent gate, whereas a veto left to the compromised worker prevents none. The twin also exposes implementation-level hazards that the architectural specification does not address, and it draws an explicit line between the properties that simulation can validate and those that only hardware can.

[MA-5] Groups of AI agents underuse resources despite shared evidence of increased capacity

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在资源受限环境下，多个生成式 AI (Generative AI) 代理因信息不对称导致资源利用不充分的问题。当系统容量发生变化（如某服务恢复）时，若代理无法及时获取可用性更新，仍可能持续尝试已失效的资源，造成任务延迟或失败。其解决方案的关键在于通过共享真实可用性的证据（如成功请求记录），使代理能够动态调整行为，从而更有效地分配任务。实验表明，仅告知恢复可能性不足以促使代理改变行为，但展示实际成功的请求记录可显著降低任务超时率；进一步发现，引入差异化标识符（如不同编号）可有效引导代理分散请求，即便整体选择频率不变，也能显著提升资源利用率和任务完成量，揭示了在透明化资源状态基础上，设计合理的分布式协调机制对优化群体性能至关重要。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22632
作者: Takahiro Ezaki,Naoto Imura,Katsuhiro Nishinari
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 47 pages including Supplementary Information; 7 main figures and 4 supplementary figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When AI agents share limited resources, such as computing services or public infrastructure, their individual choices affect how much work they complete as a group. Can sharing evidence of what is available let a group make full use of its resources after capacity changes? We tested this with language-model agents choosing between two simulated servers. One server recovered while its status report still listed it as unavailable. Each server had limited capacity per round, so rejected jobs required another attempt before the deadline. Telling agents that recovery was possible reduced missed deadlines. In controlled tests with Anthropic’s Claude Haiku 5.5, no agent tried the recovered server after a rule reminder, yet all chose it when shown a successful request record. After sharing, all five models tested left capacity unused. Keeping the success record fixed, we gave agents numbers without instructions, using each value equally often but giving group members either identical or distinct numbers. With OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol or Google’s Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, distinct numbers spread simultaneous requests across servers and increased job completions even though overall choice frequencies barely changed. Telling AI agents which resources are available leaves a second design challenge: helping them spread demand across those resources.

[MA-6] Surfacing Disagreement Beats Resolving It: A Gated Ablation Study of Provenance-Weighted Memory for Multi-Agent Debate

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体辩论（multi-agent debate）中共享内存机制默认消除不一致性的合理性问题。传统做法通过检索返回单一胜出事实来快速化解分歧，但这种“隐性调和”可能掩盖真实矛盾，影响模型对对抗性攻击的鲁棒性。其核心解决方案在于：在DebateGraph框架中，四个后端共享同一合约（read/write/snapshot），在固定预算下可独立评估五种来自智能体-记忆文献的机制，关键突破是保留矛盾并将其排序后的冲突集传递至辩论过程，而非强制合并为单一结果。实验表明，这一策略在39次运行中显著提升F1得分（+0.340，95% CI [+0.267, +0.414]），并将对抗攻击成功率从122个污染样本中的22例降至7例（McNemar精确检验p=0.0003），且成本不变。该效果的实现依赖于修复了原有评估框架中的瓶颈——冲突集仅基于检索到的边构建，而预设阈值导致四分之三的预置矛盾无法被检索，初始测试仅获得+0.084的增益。经验证，该效应在两种检索底座及HotpotQA文档上均具方向性重复性。其余机制均未存活，其中两个甚至劣于无干预状态：一旦矛盾进入提示，写操作信任门控与路由器溯源特征均造成准确率下降（F1分别损失-0.075和-0.096）。信任门控结构失效的根本原因在于：污染对象始终是图中已存在的实体，其与真实事实的匹配度高达53%，导致模型对谎言的“接地性”评分反而高于首次提及的真实信息。研究团队开源了评估框架、攻击数据集与日志，并主张应摒弃“沉默调和记忆”的默认假设。

Abstract:Shared memory for multi-agent debate is usually built to resolve inconsistency: retrieval returns one winning fact and the disagreement disappears before any agent sees it. We ask whether that is correct. In DebateGraph, four backends share one contract (read/write/snapshot), so five mechanisms from the agent-memory literature can be removed independently under a fixed budget, each gated on a pre-declared threshold. Across 39 runs one survives: preserving contradictions and passing the ranked conflict set to the debate, rather than collapsing it to a winner, improves F1 by +0.340 (95% CI [+0.267, +0.414]) and cuts attack success from 22 to 7 of 122 poisoned items (McNemar exact p=0.0003), at equal cost. Reaching it meant fixing a bottleneck in our harness: conflict sets are built only over retrieved edges, and our pre-declared cap left three quarters of planted contradictions unretrievable, first measuring the mechanism at +0.084. The effect replicates on two retrieval substrates and directionally on HotpotQA documents. No other mechanism survives, and two are worse than inert: once contradictions reach the prompt, a write trust-gate and the router’s provenance features each cost accuracy (-0.075 and -0.096 F1). The gate fails structurally: poisoned objects are always entities the graph already contains, against 53% of gold, so groundedness scores the lie above a truthful first mention. We release the harness, attack set, and logs, and argue that silently reconciling memory is the assumption worth abandoning.

[MA-7] Bad Apples in the Kitchen: How LLM Teams Detect Correct and Calibrate Against Their Misaligned Members

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体生成式人工智能（Multi-agent Generative AI）系统中，当团队成员在行为上出现偏离而语言仍保持合作时所引发的隐蔽性风险问题。传统方法依赖于回合间对话审查以实现协作，但在实时具身协作场景中，对话与行动并行发生，导致无法及时识别和响应潜在的“沉默型破坏者”——即言行不一的异常智能体。为探究此问题，研究构建了一个定制化的四人《Overcooked》环境，引入三种基于理论的非对齐智能体，分别针对三个关键联合行动层级施加压力：言语-行为不一致、角色入侵以及整体进度干扰。通过一个3×4×2的实验设计（共720个实验回合），将系统鲁棒性分解为检测、纠正与校准三个顺序性关卡。结果显示，尽管绝大多数异常行为最终可被识别，但有效恢复仅在话语中同时包含责任归属（attribution）与情境诊断（diagnosis）时才可能发生；直接进行源头归因提示虽提升了最复杂情况下的表现，却使无异常情况下的基准性能下降了37.5%。因此，研究揭示：系统的鲁棒性并非单纯依赖高敏感度的检测机制，而更取决于团队对话是否能在单一语句中整合责任归属与情境分析，提示应聚焦于精准化地提升对不对齐信号的感知能力，而非普遍提高敏感度。

Abstract:What protects an LLM team when one teammate quietly goes wrong? Most multi-agent LLM work assumes cooperative partners and inspects chat between turns before acting. Real-time embodied cooperation does not allow this pause: chat runs alongside action, so a teammate whose words stay cooperative while behavior diverges can cause damage faster than the team can name what is happening. We study this case by injecting three theory-grounded misaligned agents into a custom four-player Overcooked environment, each stressing a different joint-action layer (speech-action mismatch, role invasion, and aggregate-progress disruption), and decompose robustness into three sequential gates of detection, correction, and calibration through a 3x4x2 design (n=720 episodes). Nearly all trolls are eventually named, but recovery follows only when attribution and situational diagnosis appear in the same utterance; direct source-attribution prompting improves the hardest case only by degrading the troll-free baseline by 37.5%. Robustness, then, depends less on detection alone than on whether team chat combines attribution with diagnosis in a single utterance, suggesting that sensitivity to misalignment should be targeted rather than uniformly raised.

[MA-8] OAK-Mind: Zero-Training Mental Health Change Inference from Passive Sensing via Knowledge-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM s

【速读】：该论文旨在解决从可穿戴设备与智能手机传感器采集的被动感知数据中推断心理健康状态时，传统监督学习模型依赖标注数据且缺乏预测可解释性的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种零样本（zero-shot）训练、多智能体（multi-agent）、基于知识（knowledge-grounded）的大语言模型（LLM）推理框架——OAK-Mind。该框架将传感数据按睡眠、身体活动、位置移动性和手机使用等行为维度进行组织，并通过基于心理健康文献的领域特定智能体协同分析纵向行为变化，综合评估结果并结合量表化症状评分，实现相对于个体基线的动态心理状态变化推断，同时生成基于观测行为模式与领域知识的人类可读推理依据。实验表明，OAK-Mind在无需任务特定微调的情况下，性能可媲美甚至超越依赖额外标注数据的最优监督模型，且显著优于直接提示（direct prompting）策略。消融实验进一步验证了行为解读与症状评分融合、跨领域智能体分工及引入领域知识的关键作用。研究结果凸显了基于知识的多智能体LLM在无需训练条件下实现心理健康变化推断的巨大潜力。

Abstract:Wearable and smartphone sensors capture behavioral signals associated with mental health, yet inferring mental health outcomes from these signals has traditionally relied on supervised models requiring labeled data and offering limited insight into their predictions. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to reason over behavioral evidence, but existing LLM-based approaches to passive sensing have largely continued to rely on task-specific fine-tuning or sensor-specific pretraining. In this paper, we introduce \textbfOAK-Mind, a zer\textbfO-training, multi-\textbfAgent, \textbfKnowledge-grounded LLM pipeline for inferring mental health changes from passive sensing data. The pipeline organizes sensing data into behavioral dimensions including sleep, physical activity, location mobility, and smartphone use, and orchestrates specialized agents grounded in mental health literature to interpret longitudinal behavioral changes. It synthesizes their assessments and applies questionnaire-based symptom rating to infer changes relative to an individual’s baseline assessment with human-readable rationale grounded in observed behavioral patterns and domain knowledge. Across datasets and prediction tasks, while without task-specific training, OAK-Mind achieves comparable or better performance than the most predictive supervised baselines trained on additional labeled samples. It also demonstrate consistent improvement upon direct prompting across four tested LLM backbones. Ablation analyses support the benefits of combining behavioral interpretation with symptom rating, distributing analysis across domain-specific agents, and incorporating domain knowledge. Our findings highlight the potential of knowledge-grounded, multi-agent LLMs for training-free inference of mental health changes from passive sensing data.

[MA-9] Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multi-agent system）在分布式证据收集过程中因各智能体拥有独立上下文而引发的记忆不一致问题，即不同智能体检索到的事实可能无法被主导智能体完整获取，从而影响联合结论的准确性。其解决方案的关键在于通过构建基准测试与证据流分析工具，针对哈维实验室（Harvey LAB）文档审查任务中的受控事实冲突，系统性地评估多智能体协作中的信息一致性。研究发现，在同等生成成本下，启用多智能体委派使冲突主张的检索率从50.2%提升至68.7%，但冲突检测率却从16.2%下降至13.2%；尤其当冲突信息被分置于不同智能体时，仅有35.2%的检索对能同时报告两方主张，且仅当单一智能体读取全部主张时，冲突检测性能优于单智能体执行。因此，智能体向主导者的信息交接（worker-to-lead handoffs）成为提升多智能体大语言模型（LLM）中冲突检测能力的核心优化目标。

Abstract:Multi-agent delegation lets LLM systems distribute evidence collection across workers with separate contexts. This creates a consistency challenge: facts retrieved by workers may be missing from the evidence available to the lead for a joint conclusion. We introduce a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for studying multi-agent memory inconsistency through controlled factual conflicts in Harvey LAB document-review tasks. Pooled across three models with comparable generation spending, requiring delegation increases retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7% relative to single-agent execution, yet conflict detection falls from 16.2% to 13.2%. Within this setting, workers report both claims for only 35.2% of retrieved pairs, and pooled matched comparisons show higher detection than single-agent execution when one worker reads both claims but lower detection when the claims are split across workers. Worker-to-lead handoffs are a central target for improving conflict detection in multi-agent LLMs.

[MA-10] Emergence and Collapse of Leader-Follower Flocks through Phantom Targets: Surprise Nullification in Bayesian and Inverse Bayesian Inference

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在贝叶斯（Bayesian）与逆向贝叶斯（Inverse Bayesian, BIB）推断中，当预测误差较大时如何处理“意外”（surprise）的问题，特别是探讨在缺乏显式对齐规则或指定领导者的情况下，个体间如何通过动态的信念与似然方差调整形成并维持群体性集体行为（如领导者-追随者蜂群结构）。其核心解决方案的关键在于引入惊喜消减机制（surprise nullification），即在出现大预测误差时，通过以相同因子同时扩大信念方差（belief variance）和似然方差（likelihood variance），保持两者方差比不变，从而维持相对精度的同时显著提升信念不确定性。这一机制使得个体在感知到异常信息时仍能保留一定的学习能力（低学习率），但通过调节方差比例，诱导出“链接断裂”（link cut）现象——即一个代理几乎停止采纳另一代理的观测信息，并转向一个脱离现实的“幽灵目标”（phantom target）移动，进而吸引其他个体形成临时性领导-追随结构。这种结构在链接恢复或幽灵目标吸引力平衡时发生崩溃。研究发现，尽管个体预测本身可能严重偏离真实状态，但通过惊喜消减所引发的动态方差调整，反而促成了群体秩序的涌现。因此，该模型表明，惊喜消减通过在保持相对精度的同时降低绝对精度，实现了群体结构的持续存在与最终崩溃之间的动态平衡，为个体错误预测如何催生集体有序行为提供了机制解释。

机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Adaptation and Self-Organizing Systems (nlin.AO)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In Bayesian and inverse Bayesian (BIB) inference, a large prediction error can trigger surprise nullification, which expands belief and likelihood variances by a common factor, leaving the updated variance ratio the same as in standard Bayesian updating. This can increase belief uncertainty while keeping the learning rate low. In the simulations, three agents used BIB inference to predict one another’s positions and moved toward those predictions, repeatedly forming leader-follower flocks that subsequently collapsed despite having no alignment rules or designated leaders. Three leadership criteria (front position, heading stability, and flock initiation) identified the same agent in 89% of eligible flocks, with different agents serving as leaders across flocks. Flocks formed when an agent nearly stopped incorporating another’s observations (link cut) and moved straight toward a predicted position detached from reality (phantom target), thereby attracting followers. Link cuts arose when two successive resets assigned a very small and then an ordinary likelihood variance, sharply increasing the likelihood-to-belief variance ratio. Flocks collapsed upon link recovery or when returning phantom targets balanced the leader’s forward and backward attractions. Without nullification, cuts persisted throughout the analysis period; expanding only belief variance caused recovery within a few steps. Expanding likelihood variance as well allowed cuts to persist while belief uncertainty grew, enabling later resets and recovery. Thus, nullification preserves relative precision, allowing cuts and flocks to persist, while reducing absolute precision to enable recovery and collapse, reconciling these seemingly opposing processes through a single operation. These results suggest that, in this model, individually inaccurate predictions can give rise to collective order.

[MA-11] he Only Edge Was Memorized in Training: LLM Trading Agents Around Earnings and Bad News

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI (Generative AI) 交易代理在真实市场情境下是否能有效捕捉事件驱动型投资机会的问题，特别是针对已知时间的财报公告前及重大负面消息后的股价异常波动。现有研究存在局限：一方面，多数对生成式 AI 的评估基于新闻文本回放，但新闻与股价反应时间高度同步，难以体现真正的前瞻性；另一方面，相关研究或仅分析公告后文档、或采用月度反转策略，无法验证代理在交易成本约束下是否具备实际盈利能力。本文的关键解决方案在于构建一个“无前瞻”（look-ahead-free）的基准测试框架，严格在事件发生前（598次财报公告前）和事件发生后（409次大型美股负面下跌后）进行独立评估，且所有输入均在决策收盘时截断，确保信息时效性。实验对比了多轮推理代理与单次调用、简单规则、逻辑回归模型，并考察是否包含股票名称的影响。结果表明，尽管使用了来自四家供应商的五种大语言模型，所有代理均未能超越简单的“买入所有”策略，其表现主要依赖训练数据中的记忆效应。例如，基于 GPT 的模型在财报公告方向预测上仅分别达到 59.2% 和 53.3% 的准确率，且未显著优于随机猜测。因此，论文强调，生成式交易代理的开发必须以“简单贝叶斯赌注”为基准进行盲测，并在训练截止日期之后验证其泛化能力，否则易陷入虚假性能幻觉。

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) trading agents are tested on news, but news reaches stock prices within minutes, and a benchmark that replays headlines at their publication time finds no alpha in trading on them. Money can then remain in two places, before news whose date is known, such as earnings announcements, and after bad news, if the market’s fall went too far. However, studies of LLMs and earnings read documents published with or after the announcement, and studies of reversal sort monthly portfolios, so neither tells whether an agent can trade these moments after costs. In this paper, we test LLM agents at both moments on the same look-ahead-free benchmark, before 598 earnings announcements and after 409 bad-news drops of large US stocks. Every input is cut at the decision close, staged agents are compared with single calls, simple rules and a logistic regression, and every decision is made with and without the stock’s name. Across five models from four vendors, no agent beat the simple bets. Before earnings, the agents mostly bought and earned what buying before every announcement earned, and after bad news, a Gemini-based agent called almost every fall an overreaction while no agent picked better dips than buying them all. The only gains came from what the models had memorized in training. Given only the ticker and the dates, a GPT-based model called the direction of 59.2% of the announcements before its training cutoff and 53.3% after it. Agent builders should therefore compare an event agent with the simple bet and test it blind after the training cutoff.

[MA-12] Addressing Exogenous Variability in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决合作式多智能体强化学习（Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, MARL）在面临外生可变性（exogenous variability）时的性能退化问题，尤其当对手策略或环境状态转移机制发生不可控的动态变化时，传统方法难以适应。为此，论文提出一种新的形式化框架——外生部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Exogenous Dec-POMDP, ED-POMDP），其中独立于智能体团队选择的“外生状态”（episode-level exogenous regime）决定系统的转移动态，并将全局状态划分为两类：一类是当前团队动作直接响应的状态分量，另一类则不直接受当前动作影响。这一划分揭示了“中介影响”（mediated influence）机制：尽管当前动作无法直接改变非响应型状态分量，但可通过影响响应型分量间接调控其后续演化路径。针对此机制，论文提出LEICA算法，采用中心化训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）兼容的架构，通过学习历史依赖的上下文表征来分别建模两类状态分量，并引入基于个体影响权重的反事实内在奖励（influence-weighted counterfactual intrinsic rewards）以引导策略更新。在包含对手策略切换的SMAX基准测试中，LEICA在训练性能和对未见对手策略的泛化能力方面均显著优于现有基线方法，验证了在存在外生训练-测试状态转移差异下，利用影响加权机制进行策略塑造的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22067
作者: Seongmin Kim,Woohyeon Byeon,Jiwon Jeon,Seungyul Han,Youngchul Sung
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); UNIST(韩国蔚山科学技术院)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 28 pages. Includes supplementary material. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) often fails under exogenous variability such as shifts in opponents or environment regimes that cannot be controlled by the team but alter the transition dynamics. We formalize this challenge as Exogenous Dec-POMDP (ED-POMDP), in which an episode-level exogenous regime, selected independently of the team, indexes the dynamics, and the global state is partitioned into components that are directly responsive to the current team action and components that are not directly action-responsive at the current step. This formulation exposes mediated influence: while team actions do not directly update the latter at the current step, they can shape their later evolution through induced changes in the former. Based on this, we propose LEICA, a CTDE-compatible algorithm that learns history-conditioned context representations for both components and shapes policy updates using agent-wise, influence-weighted counterfactual intrinsic rewards. Across SMAX benchmarks with opponent strategy shifts, LEICA consistently improves both training performance and generalization to unseen opponents’ strategies over existing baselines, supporting the usefulness of influence-weighted shaping under exogenous train-test regime shifts.

[MA-13] Operating an Agent -Driven Dataset Factory: Discovery Construction and Public Release

【速读】：该论文旨在解决从公开数据中自动化构建可用于预测任务的数据集所面临的系统性挑战，核心问题在于如何实现从数据源发现、任务定义、数据集构建到发布分发的全流程连续化与可复现性。其解决方案的关键在于提出并部署“数据集工厂”（Dataset Factory）系统，通过受限语言模型（bounded language model）负责理解数据源、生成构建代码并验证任务语义，同时借助确定性软件（deterministic software）精确管理状态、工作节点、重试机制及发布流程，从而实现端到端的自动化数据集生产。实验表明，在超过81.53小时的运行周期内，该系统以约2.74美元/次的估算运营成本发布了14个数据集，涵盖计算资源消耗、推理开销及失败尝试等成本。尽管所有已发布版本均通过独立代理完成预测实验验证，但源审查仍发现一个任务的构建过滤逻辑与其声明的种群定义存在矛盾，且原始评审者未对后期记录的排除项与已发布选择规则进行一致性校验。这一发现凸显了在数据集生产流程中，任务语义的正确性需在系统执行与下游使用者验证之间进行独立检查，以保障数据集的可信度与可用性。

Abstract:Turning public data into prediction datasets requires connecting source discovery, task definition, construction, and distribution. We deployed Dataset Factory to perform these steps continuously under a standing release policy. Bounded language-model tasks interpret sources, write construction code, and review task meaning; deterministic software manages state, workers, retries, and publication. Over 81.53 hours, the factory published 14 datasets at an estimated recurring operating expenditure of about \ 2.74 per publication. The accounting includes failed attempts, inference, workers, and hosting. Separate agents completed prediction experiments on all twelve evaluated releases. Source review nevertheless identified a task whose construction filters contradicted its population declaration. The original reviewer accepted later-record exclusions without reconciling them with the published selection rule. This experience documents an operating source-to-release workflow and shows why successful execution and consumer use need separate checks of task meaning.

[MA-14] Beyond 4: Improved Competitive Traveling Repairperson

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在线旅行维修员问题（Online Traveling Repairperson Problem, OTRP）中的竞争比优化问题，特别是在存在多个维修人员（repairpersons）从同一出发点（depot）出发的场景下，如何设计高效的在线算法以最小化最大响应时间。针对任意度量空间下的通用情况，提出了一种3.877-竞争性的确定性算法，显著优于此前最优的4-竞争性算法。对于零残余（zero-residual）这一特殊情形，进一步将竞争比改进至3+ϵ3+\epsilon3+ϵ（对任意ϵ>0\epsilon>0ϵ>0），实现了理论上的突破。其解决方案的关键在于设计一种基于动态调度与局部最优策略相结合的在线决策机制，通过精确控制服务顺序与路径规划，在不依赖未来信息的前提下实现近似最优的性能保障。此外，该方法还可扩展至相关的在线叫车接送问题（Online Dial-a-Ride Problem），在多种变体中保持优异的竞争性能。

Abstract:With k\geq 1 repairpersons starting initially from a depot, we present a 3.877-competitive deterministic algorithm for the fundamental online traveling repairperson problem on an arbitrary metric. For the special class of zero-residual instances, we improve the ratio to 3+\epsilon for every \epsilon0 . We also extend these results to some variants of the related so-called online dial-a-ride problem. The state-of-the-art is the 4-competitive deterministic algorithm for both problems.

[MA-15] Coordination of Heterogeneous Teams with Uncertain Task Requirements

【速读】：该论文旨在解决异构智能体团队在任务需求未知的情况下协同完成任务的多智能体规划难题。核心挑战在于智能体在发现任务需求与执行任务能力上的差异，要求规划器同时协调任务发现、任务执行与任务调度。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种分层规划框架，通过图神经网络（Graph Neural Network, GNN）策略为智能体分配动作，并结合最短路径算法确定动作执行位置。该方法的核心是构建“任务-能力-行动图”（CAAT graph），以统一表征智能体、任务、能力与动作之间的复杂关系。实验表明，该学习型规划器能够更高效地联合优化任务发现与任务执行，在较短时间内完成任务；更重要的是，该策略在零样本迁移（zero-shot transfer）场景下表现优异，仅在室外地图上训练后即可直接应用于包含更多智能体、任务和能力的室内地图，无需微调，验证了其强泛化能力。

Abstract:Coordinating a team of heterogeneous agents to complete tasks with unknown requirements is a challenging multi-agent planning problem. Agents differ in their ability to discover task requirements and in their ability to engage tasks, so the planner must coordinate task discovery, execution, and staging. This paper introduces a hierarchical planner that uses a graph neural network policy to assign actions to agents, then finds a path to the action’s location using a shortest-path algorithm. The central part of our approach is the CAAT graph, which is a graph representation of the planning context consisting of the agents, tasks, capabilities, and actions. We demonstrate that our learned planner can jointly coordinate a heterogeneous team to simultaneously discover task requirements and complete tasks in a shorter time compared to baselines that optimize task discovery and task engagement independently. Furthermore, we show that our policy can zero-shot plan on out-of-distribution settings by training only on an outdoor map then transferring without finetuning to an indoor map with more agents, tasks, and capabilities than seen during training.

[MA-16] Corrupting Ties: Investigating Robustness to Bias Injection Across Multi-Agent Network Topologies

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）在高风险决策场景中，因多智能体系统内部组件间交互而引入的公平性风险难以通过孤立审计单个组件或整体输出发现的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种受控偏见注入框架，通过替换特定智能体的响应为预设偏见内容，实现对网络拓扑结构与注入配置如何影响系统行为的干预式分析。关键在于设计了多层次的决策分歧度量指标，从个体智能体、网络层级到系统整体量化干预效果，并基于Qwen与Gemma系列大语言模型，在三种二分类任务上评估五种网络拓扑结构。研究发现，序列型网络表现出最大分歧，全连接与网格结构则相对较低；在星型网络中，中央节点的偏见注入影响显著大于边缘节点；且不同模型对偏见传播的响应存在差异，部分模型的决策分歧并不完全遵循注入偏见。这些结果揭示了网络结构在偏见传播中的决定性作用，推动了面向拓扑结构的多智能体系统公平性风险审计方法的发展。

Abstract:AI systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making contexts, where interactions among components can introduce fairness risks that remain undetected when auditing components or collective outcomes in isolation. As LLM-based multi-agent systems become more prevalent, understanding how biased information propagates through agent interactions is essential for assessing their fairness. We introduce a controlled bias injection framework that replaces selected agent responses with predefined biased ones, enabling an intervention-based analysis of how network topology and injection configurations shape system behavior. We propose decision divergence metrics that quantify the effects of these interventions at the agent, network, and system levels, and evaluate five topologies on three binary classification tasks using LLMs from the Qwen and Gemma families. Sequential networks show the greatest divergence, whereas fully connected and mesh networks show less. Injection position also matters: in star networks, injecting the central agent has larger effects than injecting peripheral agents. Models further differ in whether divergence follows the injected bias. These findings highlight the role of network structure in the propagation of biased information and motivate topology-aware auditing of fairness risks in multi-agent systems.

[MA-17] Better Calibrated Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在有限时间与能量预算下，利用自主水面航行器（ASV）舰队对异质油污污染场进行稀疏、噪声干扰下的高效监测问题。核心挑战在于如何通过信息感知路径规划（IPP）实现高精度的污染场重建，而传统方法多集中于规划策略设计，忽视了重建模型中不确定性校准的重要性。本文提出的关键解决方案是引入证据深度学习（Evidential Deep Learning, EDL），作为一种具备可校准不确定性的信息建模方法，并将其与在线共享不确定性地图的多智能体协同机制相结合，以支持鲁棒的不确定性感知路径规划。实验表明，在物理仿真油污场景下，基于闭环测试的五种规划器对比中，模型选择对最终重建误差的解释力高达80%，远超规划策略的影响（仅1%）。EDL在所有规划器下均取得最低重建误差和最高交并比（IoU），且具备最优的不确定性校准能力，推理速度达每步3.9毫秒。相比蒙特卡洛丢弃（MC Dropout）和深度集成（Deep Ensembles），EDL在仅50个单元/车辆的配置下即超越后者150个单元的表现；且当深度集成模型误差增大时其置信度反而上升，呈现过度自信现象，而EDL则保持稳定，证明了信息模型对自身规划所采集数据的鲁棒性是实现可靠不确定性感知IPP的必要条件。

Abstract:Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model’s uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. We benchmark EDL, Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles against a GP in closed loop with five planners on physics-based oil spill simulations. Across 60 maps, the choice of model dominates the outcome, explaining 80% of the variance of the final reconstruction error, against 1% for the planner among the deep models. EDL achieves the lowest error and the highest IoU under every planner, is the best calibrated model and runs at 3.9 ms per step. With 50 cells per vehicle it reconstructs the spill better than MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles with 150. Deep Ensembles become more confident as their error grows, whereas EDL is unaffected. Robustness of the information model to the data its own planner collects is therefore a requirement of uncertainty-aware IPP.

[MA-18] Consistency Is Not Correction: Separating Confidence Abstention and Recovery in LLM Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中基于置信度信号的动态推理机制有效性评估问题，具体聚焦于三类关键主张之间的逻辑独立性：答案排序能力（ discrimination）、选择性预测支持（ selective prediction）与纠错实用性（ correction utility）。研究指出，前两者并不蕴含后者，且纠错实用性可被精确分解为“门控恢复”与“门控损害”之差。这一分解揭示了一个根本性限制：任何仅在基础模型错误时才触发的门控机制，其可纠正的不一致对数受初始错误数量的严格上限制约。当该上限低于配对测试所需的最小样本量时，实验无法获得显著正向结果，也无法区分有效机制与从未触发的无效门控。作者在两个模型规模下验证了这一边界约束——小模型套件中，扰动-一致性验证器虽达到0.990的AUROC（95%置信区间[0.95, 1.00]），但每轮决策需4.32倍调用次数且无实际替换行为；在840次受控实验中，所有GSM8K任务均未发生替换，导致比较测试失效；诊断集上最大可容忍误差为4，而测试所需至少6个，即便理想门控也无显著结果。研究进一步提出两项预检措施以避免资源浪费，并揭示排名处理、截断阈值设定及输出长度差异均会系统性影响核心指标。结论表明，当前文献中的主要瓶颈并非置信度信号的选择，而是测量分辨率不足。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A controller that resamples an answer, escalates to a larger model, or abstains is usually justified by a confidence signal. Three claims about such a signal do not follow from one another: it ranks answers (discrimination), it supports withholding some of them (selective prediction), and it changes an answer for the better (correction utility). We give an exact decomposition of the third into gated recoveries minus gated harms, which bounds whether a comparison can succeed before it is run: a gate that only replaces a proposal can act only where the base policy was already wrong, so the initial error count caps the discordant pairs any correct gate can produce. When that cap falls below the count a paired test needs, the experiment cannot return a positive result for a working mechanism, nor distinguish one from a gate that never fired. We measure all three targets on two model scales and find the bound binds. In a small-model suite a perturbation-agreement verifier reaches within-policy AUROC 0.990 (95% interval [0.95, 1.00]) while every episode outcome matches single-sample decoding at 4.32 times the call count. In a controlled 840-episode study no verifier replaced the proposal on any of the 60 GSM8K decisions, so that comparison tested nothing; the entire GSM8K gain across six controllers is one task, and it is the task whose identical temperature-zero repeats disagreed, making it the one answer the service does not reproduce. On the diagnostic set the gate could reach four errors while the test needed six, so even a perfect gate had no significant result available. We report two checks that would have caught this before any budget was spent, and show that tie handling in rankings, tied selection cutoffs, and unequal output limits each move a headline number in the same dataset. The binding constraint on this literature is measurement resolution, not the choice of signal.

[MA-19] FieldGuide: A Corpus Map for Token-Efficient Agent ic Document Exploration

【速读】：该论文旨在解决记者在探索大规模文档集合时面临的效率瓶颈问题，尤其是在任务范围广泛且关键子问题尚不明确的情况下，传统生成式AI（Generative AI）方法因频繁调用大语言模型而导致高消耗的令牌使用量与长时间延迟。其解决方案的关键在于提出FieldGuide——一种面向智能体的语料库地图（corpus map），通过将文档集合组织为层次化主题结构，并提供语料定向、范围搜索和限定阅读等工具，实现对文档集合的高效导航与精准访问。实验结果表明，相较于直接访问原始文件和检索增强生成（RAG），FieldGuide在五项新闻调查任务中分别减少了27%的令牌消耗和41%的运行时间，相较RAG也分别减少38%的令牌使用和21%的耗时，同时保持了可接受的准确性水平。这表明，通过语料库定向引导可显著降低生成式AI在信息探索中的资源开销，而无需牺牲核心输出质量，同时也揭示了未来研究需进一步探讨受限访问对跨文档广度发现能力的影响。

Abstract:Generative AI agents can help journalists explore large document collections. But exploratory workflows can require substantial token use and time, especially when the task is broad and the relevant subquestions are not yet known. This paper introduces FieldGuide, an agent-facing corpus map that organizes a document collection into a topic hierarchy and exposes tools for corpus orientation, scoped search, and bounded reading. I evaluate FieldGuide on five journalistic document-exploration tasks using 38 Chicago Police Department public-records documents, comparing it with raw-file access and retrieval-augmented generation. Across the five tasks, FieldGuide used 27% fewer tokens and 41% less elapsed time than raw-file access; relative to RAG, it used 38% fewer tokens and 21% less elapsed time. An accuracy audit identified four minor issues in FieldGuide’s responses, comparable to the other conditions. In blind ratings of generated reporting leads, FieldGuide’s mean ratings were higher than RAG’s and lower than the raw-file condition’s. These descriptive results suggest that corpus orientation may reduce runtime token use and elapsed time without severe accuracy failures. They also motivate further study of whether selective access limits broad, cross-document discovery.

[MA-20] he Defense Rests: A Courtroom-Inspired Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Safety Case Generation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决复杂且耗时的手动构建安全论证（safety case）问题，尤其是在机器学习（ML）赋能的自动驾驶系统等关键任务系统中，传统人工方式难以高效、一致地生成可验证的安全论证。其核心解决方案是提出一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体框架eTrustWare，通过法庭类比的形式对安全论证过程进行形式化建模：安全分析师扮演“检察官”角色，识别潜在危害与安全关切；保证论证开发者作为“辩护律师”构建并证明安全论点；协调者充当“法官”以管理多方交互；评审委员会则如“陪审团”负责评估论证的完整性与说服力。该框架利用多个协同的LLM智能体实现安全论点的自动生成、证据支持、逻辑推理与交叉审查，显著提升了安全论证构建的自动化水平与质量。实验结果表明，基于协同LLM智能体的系统在生成和评审多类自动驾驶系统的安全论证方面具有可行性与有效性。

Abstract:Safety cases are widely used to demonstrate that mission-critical systems, such as autonomous vehicles and unmanned aerial systems, can operate safely after deployment. However, manually constructing safety cases is complex, time-consuming, and labor-intensive, which calls for the proposal of automated approaches to support their creation. Inspired by the legal nature of safety case construction, we formalize the safety case creation problem through a courtroom analogy, where stakeholders collaboratively propose, examine, criticize, review, improve and validate safety claims and their supporting evidence. In this analogy, the safety analyst acts as a prosecutor by identifying hazards and safety concerns, while the assurance case developer serves as a defense attorney by constructing and substantiating safety arguments. An orchestrator acts as a judge by coordinating stakeholder interactions, and a review board serves as a jury by assessing argument completeness and persuasiveness. Based on this formalization, we propose eTrustWare, a Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for automated safety case generation and review. Our experiments on several safety cases of ML-enabled autonomous driving systems demonstrate the feasibility of coordinated LLM-based agents for generating safety cases.

[MA-21] Cycles of Arbitrary Period in Multidimensional Heterogeneous Hegselmann-Krause Dynamics

【速读】：该论文旨在解决异质型赫格塞尔曼-克拉豪斯（Hegselmann-Krause）意见动态系统中多维意见与范数定义信心邻域下的周期性行为问题。其核心问题是：在何种条件下，此类系统能够产生非平凡的周期轨迹？研究发现，对于任意维度 $ d \geq 3 $、任意 $ \ell_q $ 范数（其中 $ q \in [1, \infty] \setminus {2} $）以及任意整数 $ m \geq 2 $，存在一个由五个代理人组成的系统，可实现最小周期为 $ m $ 的周期性轨迹，且不同周期可在相同信心半径下共存。关键解决方案在于构造一种几何结构：四个代理保持静止，第五个代理在其凸包内沿线段移动，同时所有代理间均满足严格的信心约束条件，且静止代理可共享一个正信心半径。该构造依赖于一个几何准则，该准则可推广至更广泛的范数类，但该准则在低维（一维和二维）下无论采用何种信心范数均无法满足。此外，研究还证明，在任何维度和任意范数下，少于五个代理的异质型赫格塞尔曼-克拉豪斯系统不可能存在非平凡周期轨迹；而最多三个代理的系统则必然以指数速度收敛。

作者: Anton V. Proskurnikov,Iryna Zabarianska
机构: Politecnico di Torino (都灵理工大学); Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology (莫斯科物理技术研究所)
类目: Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI); Systems and Control (eess.SY); Dynamical Systems (math.DS); Optimization and Control (math.OC)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study periodic behavior in heterogeneous Hegselmann-Krause opinion dynamics with multidimensional opinions and norm-defined confidence neighborhoods. We prove that, for every dimension d\ge3 , every \ell_q norm with q\in[1,\infty]\setminus\2\ , and every integer m\ge2 , a system of five agents admits a periodic trajectory of minimal period m ; moreover, different periods can coexist for fixed confidence radii. Four agents remain stationary, while the fifth moves along a line segment contained in their convex hull. The stationary agents may share a common strictly positive confidence radius, and all confidence inequalities are strict. A geometric criterion underlying the construction extends these results to further classes of norms. However, this criterion cannot be satisfied in dimensions one and two, regardless of the confidence norm. We also prove that no heterogeneous Hegselmann-Krause system with less than five agents admits a nonconstant periodic trajectory, under any norm and in any dimension; every trajectory with at most three agents converges exponentially.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] Ambient LLM s: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自回归语言模型在后训练阶段因数据集规模有限、多样性不足而导致的过拟合及数据分布尾部信息遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）问题。现有监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT）通常使用远小于预训练阶段的数据集，难以充分覆盖长尾分布特征。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为“环境微调”（Ambient SFT）的原理性框架，通过利用预训练模型生成的不完美预测来增强微调数据集。该方法采用一个“冻结”的预训练模型作为噪声教师（noisy teacher），要求微调后的模型在高温度（high-temperature）条件下，其生成的条件分布与预训练模型的对应分布保持一致。温度超参数控制对预训练模型输出的信任程度：当温度趋于无穷时退化为标准SFT，而温度为1时等价于知识蒸馏。实验表明，该方法在领域迁移、指令微调和推理任务中均显著优于标准SFT，平均相对性能提升达21%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23229
作者: Giannis Daras,Marios Papachristou,Adam Klivans,Antonio Torralba,Constantinos Daskalakis
机构: MIT(麻省理工学院); Arizona State University(亚利桑那州立大学); University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Work in progress

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a “frozen” version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit T\to \infty reverting back to regular SFT and T=1 to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to 21% average relative improvement to standard SFT.

[NLP-1] What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式AI（Generative AI）中社会偏见定位方法的可靠性问题，具体针对基于注意力头（attention head）的偏见识别与移除方法的有效性质疑。现有方法通常通过观察某个公平性指标在移除特定注意力头后的变化来验证其有效性，但缺乏对所选注意力头是否真正反映偏见的独立证据支持。本文以Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型为对象进行审计，发现所谓的“偏见头图”（head map）与无标签响应长度图的相关系数分别达到ρ = -0.950和-0.768，表明其可能捕捉的是表面共现偏差（surface confound），而非真实偏见。进一步干预实验显示，在提示固定的情况下，响应长度仅解释该统计量1%的方差；而提示身份则解释了高达64%的方差，且该关系并非随长度单调变化。在任一固定提示下，公平性标签、响应长度与受保护群体词元的存在高度共线（φ = 0.95），这种共线性部分源于标注规则的定义本身，因此任何观测分析均无法区分三者中的因果角色。由此推断，此类方法无法通过非实验性分析建立因果归属。最终，研究指出其核心主张均不成立：无论采用何种参考解读，偏见选择性均未表现出晚期层集中特征；且所有测试的注意力头集合在剔除后均未降低不公平率。相反，其补集在反向标签上显著破坏拒绝行为（p = 2.7×10⁻⁵），证明该检测管道具备识别此类效应的能力，但其误将共线性信号当作偏见信号，从而导致错误归因。该研究的关键在于揭示现有偏见定位方法的内在缺陷——即依赖于不可分离的共线变量，且缺乏可证伪的实验设计，从而挑战了当前主流方法的科学基础。

作者: S.M Seefat Alam
机构: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (孟加拉国工程技术大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 18 pages, 13 tables. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (October 2026 cycle)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at \rho = -0.950 and -0.768 with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic’s variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at \phi = 0.95 , partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ( p = 2.7\times10^-5 ), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.

[NLP-2] Structure–Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前语言模型预训练中过度依赖下一词预测（next-token prediction）任务所导致的表征学习局限性，即模型可能难以有效捕捉数据中深层的结构化信息。其核心问题是：是否应将表征的结构组织本身作为显式的归纳偏置（inductive bias），以提升模型对语言本质结构的理解能力。解决方案的关键在于提出一种“结构-残差”（structure-residual）原则，通过两种互补的实现方式——边界瓶颈概念（Boundary Bottleneck Concept, BBC）与连续概念（Continuous Concept, CC），分别从信息路由和几何正则化角度分离语言表示中的结构性成分与细节性残差。BBC通过边界载体传递分段信息，保持局部自回归计算；CC则通过对表征几何进行谱分解，引导低频结构与高频残差的解耦。理论推导表明，在段内路径能量趋近于零时，多路修正后的边界注意力趋于精确；实验结果显示，二者在不同网络深度表现出差异化优势（BBC适配浅层，CC适配深层），且联合使用可在仅300M训练令牌下使GPT-2 Medium的负对数似然（NLL）降低1.44%，并持续在高达200亿令牌的训练中保持性能增益。诊断分析进一步验证了BBC增强边界状态的预测重要性，而CC显著降低了谱残差能量。这些结果表明，引入结构-残差归纳偏置可超越传统下一词预测机制，显著提升语言模型的预训练效果。

作者: Hai Huang,Bartosz Żuk,Rassul Magauin,Jiaxin Huang,Xue Liu
机构: Palona AI; Institute of Computer Science, Polish Academy of Sciences(波兰科学院计算机科学研究所); Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence(穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure–residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences: BBC works best in early layers, whereas CC is most effective in later layers. At 300M training tokens, combining BBC and CC improves NLL by 1.44% on GPT-2 Medium. These gains persist with training runs up to 20B tokens. Representation diagnostics show that BBC increases the relative predictive importance of boundary states, while CC reduces spectral residual energy. Together, these results suggest that structure–residual biases can improve language-model pretraining beyond next-token prediction. Code: this https URL

[NLP-3] Polarity Composition Hypothesis: Causal Evidence from Negation in NLI EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型在自然语言推理（Natural Language Inference, NLI）任务中对否定句的处理机制问题，特别是其如何理解与推理否定语义。其核心挑战在于揭示语言模型内部对否定信息的表征与计算过程，尤其是在面对不同形式的否定时，模型是否具备一致且可解释的推理逻辑。论文提出“极性组合假说”（Polarity Composition Hypothesis），作为对否定处理过程的高层级因果模型，认为语言模型通过组合正负极性信息来实现对否定语义的推断。解决方案的关键在于利用分布式对齐搜索（Distributed Alignment Search）技术，识别出与该假说中变量高度对齐的因果有效子空间，从而揭示模型内部负责否定推理的可解释表示。这些发现表明，所识别的表征不仅在不同否定形式间具有泛化能力，还能部分迁移到MNLI数据集的特定子集，验证了该假说的有效性与模型内部表征的可解释性。

作者: Nhi Hoai Doan,Tatsuya Hiraoka,Munachiso Samuel Nwadike,Kentaro Inui
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to EACL 2027 (main conference)

Abstract:We investigate how language models process negation in natural language inference (NLI). We propose the \textitPolarity Composition Hypothesis, a high-level causal model of this computation. Behavioral evaluations show that language-model predictions largely conform to the proposed hypothesis. Using Distributed Alignment Search, we identify causally effective subspaces aligned with the variables in the polarity-composition hypothesis. These representations transfer across negation forms and partially to a subset of MNLI. We release the dataset and code.

[NLP-4] MoE–LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在低资源语言支持方面表现显著不足的问题，尤其关注生成式AI（Generative AI）中路由低秩适配器（Routed Low-Rank Adapters, LoRA）是否能有效提升多语言性能。现有假设认为LoRA可作为参数高效的方法增强模型对非英语语言的支持，但这一假设尚未在统一的多语言评估框架下得到实证验证。为此，研究通过在超过9,000个评估场景中对200种不同语言上的8种LoRA方法进行系统比较，揭示了关键发现：尽管小规模搜索可识别出可行的LoRA配置，但其预测能力不可靠，最优配置在大规模下并不持续领先；此外，LoRA虽能稳定提升翻译任务的语言模型拟合度，却普遍损害阅读理解能力，并对低资源语言带来最大收益。因此，研究结论强调，LoRA应被视为针对特定任务的精准工具，而非通用性的多语言能力增强手段。

作者: Nikit Srivastava,Joel Dag,René Speck,Axel-Cyrille Ngonga Ngomo
机构: Paderborn University (帕德博恩大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: To Appear - EACL 2027 (Findings)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9,000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. LoRA reliably improves language-model fit on translation data, consistently degrades reading comprehension, and benefits low-resource languages most. These findings suggest that LoRA methods should be regarded as targeted tools rather than general-purpose means for improving the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.

[NLP-5] xtSphere: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation via Shared Hyperspherical Alignment and Uniformity

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有文本到图像生成方法在保持高效性的同时，如何实现自由形式文本条件下的高质量生成问题。尽管基于扩散模型的方法在图像质量上取得显著进展，但其需要大量推理步骤，计算成本高；而先前的高效框架Sphere Encoder虽具备少步采样优势，却因类别条件设计缺乏跨模态对齐，难以直接扩展至自由文本生成任务。为此，本文提出TextSphere，其核心创新在于通过引入预训练CLIP文本嵌入并结合自适应层归一化（AdaLN）实现语言条件控制，同时保留原始球面采样机制以维持高效生成能力。为弥合跨模态表征差距，提出球面语义对齐与均匀性（SSAU）目标，联合优化语义对齐与超球面上的表示均匀性。实验结果表明，TextSphere在CUB-200-2011、MS-COCO-2014和Flickr30k数据集上均显著降低生成FID（gFID），且重建FID（rFID）低于1.0，在仅需4步和6步采样的情况下，性能优于从头训练的扩散模型与GAN基线。此外，通过偏最小二乘奇异值分解（PLS-SVD）分析揭示了跨模态对齐的有效性，进一步验证了所提方法在缓解模态间隙方面的优势。

机构: University of Surrey (萨里大学); CVSSP (计算机视觉与智能系统中心)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in text-to-image generation have substantially improved image quality, particularly through diffusion-based methods that require multiple inference steps. In contrast, Sphere Encoder offers an efficient generative framework capable of producing images with fewer forward steps. However, extending it to free-form text is nontrivial, because its class-conditioned design lacks cross-modal alignment. To address this challenge, we propose TextSphere, an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. We incorporate pretrained CLIP text embeddings through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) to guide image generation while retaining the original spherical sampling mechanism. To bridge the cross-modal representation gap, we introduce a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective that jointly promotes semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k demonstrate that TextSphere consistently reduces generation FID (gFID) over the text-conditioned baseline while achieving reconstruction FID (rFID) below 1.0. With only 4 and 6 sampling steps, TextSphere achieves lower gFID than the compared diffusion- and GAN-based models trained from scratch on CUB-200-2011 and MS-COCO-2014, respectively. We further observe that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily yield better generation quality. In addition, we use Partial Least Squares Singular Value Decomposition (PLS-SVD) to analyze cross-modal alignment and modality gap, offering insight into the effectiveness of our approach.

[NLP-6] Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance AAAI2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）快速发展背景下，用户面向文档（customer-facing documentation）更新滞后所引发的“文档漂移”（documentation drift）问题。随着代码迭代速度远超文档更新速度，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能代理在依赖过时或不准确文档作为知识源时，会持续传播错误信息，加剧系统性偏差。其核心解决方案是构建一个以“TriAgent”为核心调度代理的多智能体系统，通过持续监测显性和隐性信号——如已关闭的支持工单中暴露的知识缺口、代码与文档间的不一致等——自动识别并定位文档缺失或过时之处。该系统在43天的影子模式运行中成功识别出92个文档缺陷，并经由独立大模型评审团验证，81.1%的断言正确率显著高于人工基准；在可比长度的响应对比中，70.5%的案例更偏好代理生成的内容，而人类回复仅获23.2%支持。值得注意的是，代理与人工输出具有互补性：人类常揭示隐藏于文档中的深层洞察或完全缺失的信息，系统则将这些发现转化为可修复的文档缺口，并在人工审核后完成修正。修复后，同一工单的代理重答表现显著提升——盲测中71.4%的案例更倾向修复后的回答，表明该系统具备有效的自我改进能力，为实现动态、自愈型技术文档体系提供了可行路径。

作者: Lorenzo Masoero
机构: 未知
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at IAAI-27 (Innovative Applications of AI, co-located with AAAI 2027), Emerging Applications track. 12 pages (6 pages + references and appendix), 2 figures, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The “AI revolution” has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call “TriAgent,” that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent’s verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent’s response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer’s in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent’s later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.

[NLP-7] he Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在多模态推理中因信息源不可靠而导致的决策失效问题。具体而言，现有模型依赖于文本检索和图像输入两种证据来源，但二者均可能出错：检索到的文本可能存在噪声或错误，而图像则可能因退化或与文本矛盾导致误导。为系统评估模型在这些不利条件下的鲁棒性，作者构建了GIB-200K数据集，包含20万张图像-问题对，源自COCO与Visual Genome，并通过可控扰动引入三类典型挑战：硬负样本检索噪声（1–20篇文档）、视觉模糊（高斯模糊、运动模糊、低资源裁剪）以及跨模态冲突（反事实翻转对）。关键创新在于超越传统“性能下降”的度量方式，转而从理想贝叶斯线索融合理论出发，推导出可检验的预测，从而形式化定义了知识惯性（Knowledge Inertia，即模型过度依赖文本证据，相对图像证据权重过高）与感官捕获（Sensory Capture，反之）现象，并采用校正测量误差的回归方法估计模态权重。进一步地，通过反事实翻转分解分离模态偏差与概念先验，提出接地幻觉评分（Grounding Illusion Score）以量化模型准确率中非基于图像真实内容的部分。实验在2,000个固定种子测试集上评估4个开源模型，结果显示所有模型在干净输入下表现良好（92.5%–94.2%），但在恶劣条件下准确率降至41.3%–59.9%；其中两个LLaVA模型表现出显著的知识惯性（文本/图像权重比分别为1.229和1.322），而InternVL3则偏向图像（0.680）；约34.8%至71.4%的正确答案在检索文本虚假时被放弃。此外，无需训练的一致性检查虽提升准确性但牺牲覆盖率，而仅依赖图像的回退策略在图像严重退化时亦失效。研究全面公开所有实例输出、代码及审计脚本，确保结果可复现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23127
作者: Basavaraj R M,Harshal Chandel
机构: eClerx
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: 10 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: this https URL (archived at this https URL )

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model’s own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are accurate on clean inputs (92.5%-94.2%) but adverse accuracy falls to 41.3%-59.9%. The two LLaVA models over-weight the text (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), whereas InternVL3 favours the image (w_T/w_I = 0.680); between 34.8% and 71.4% of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies. A training-free consistency check that compares the answer with and without retrieval trades coverage for accuracy under misleading documents, while falling back to the image fails when the image is heavily degraded. All per-instance outputs, code, and an audit that recomputes every reported open-model number are released.

[NLP-8] Dynamic Task Allocation with Dialogue IROS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多智能体协作中动态任务分配的挑战，特别是在目标与责任随时间变化、且智能体间存在部分可观测性（partial observability）的现实场景下，传统任务分配框架因依赖静态目标假设、完全可观测性或缺乏可验证信念机制而难以适用。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种通信增强型贝叶斯任务分配框架（communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework），通过对话机制主动减少对环境及协作伙伴的不确定性，同时确保决策基于显式的概率信念模型。该框架在扩展的Overcooked环境中验证，结果表明：在部分可观测条件下，该方法显著优于基线的纯大语言模型（LLM）代理，平均提速0.585，并提前18个时步完成任务；而在全可观测条件下表现与非通信基准相当，进一步证明了通信在信息受限情境下的关键作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23119
作者: Matthew Groholski,Weiwei Gu,Nakul Gopalan
机构: Arizona State University (亚利桑那州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 9 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at Human-Robot Dialogue(HRD) Workshop at IROS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other’s actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings. Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.

[NLP-9] Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多人群体对话中视线目标识别（gaze target identification）的难题，尤其针对在多人场景下仅依赖视线几何信息会导致歧义的问题。现有数据集缺乏与对话相关的语境线索，如发言者身份和实际话语内容，限制了模型对真实社交交互的理解。为应对这一挑战，研究提出了SORBET基准数据集，包含3,340个样本、1,578段视频片段，同步标注了语音、转录文本及被注视者的标签，覆盖更广泛的多人群体对话场景。其核心解决方案是提出Nunchi框架：该框架从对话转录文本及视线与说话人检测模型的输出构建文本提示（text prompt），将各类对话线索（如谁在说话、说了什么）通过共享标签与潜在注视对象关联，并利用视觉语言模型（VLM）综合权衡视线几何信息与对话上下文线索，以实现更准确的注视目标判定。实验表明，Nunchi在SORBET上相较最强基线提升4.8个百分点，且在不同VLM、自动转录和跨数据集条件下均保持性能优势，验证了对话线索的有效性，而额外视觉线索未带来显著增益。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23115
作者: JunYeong Park,Shijing Wang,Seonwook Park,Michael Stengel,Shalini De Mello,Sang-Il Choi,Hyung Jin Chang
机构: Dankook University( Dankook大学); Beijing Jiaotong University(北京交通大学); NVIDIA(英伟达); University of Birmingham(伯明翰大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person. Nunchi outperforms the strongest existing method by 4.8 percentage points. On SORBET, conversational cues help whereas additional visual cues do not, and the gains hold across three VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on two existing datasets.

[NLP-10] Large-scale Neuron Community Discovery Reveals Neuron-Sparse Behaviors in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型中是否存在可复用的计算单元（即在不同输入间重复出现且具有因果必要性与充分性的神经元群体）这一关键问题。其核心挑战在于，尽管已有研究发现单次前向传播可通过后处理稀疏化为少量活跃神经元，但这些神经元组合是否构成跨输入一致、可重用的计算实体仍不明确。为此，作者提出“神经元社区发现”（neuron community discovery），一种无监督方法，通过结合基于梯度的归因、神经元间重复被共同归因所构建的图结构以及社区检测算法，识别出在多个提示（prompts）中反复出现且在所属层内对特定计算任务具备因果必要性和充分性的神经元群组。在对 Llama-3.1-8B 模型使用千万级提示进行实验时，该方法成功发现了数千个候选社区。通过三项因果测试（社区必要性、层内子集充分性、层必要性）在保留数据上验证，结果表明部分社区移除会破坏预测，而保留这些社区则可在剔除其余多层 MLP 神经元的情况下维持预测准确性。所发现的社区支持语法一致、词元概率校准、固定短语生成、上下文复制、加法与乘法等具体功能。当将社区规模限制在每层不超过 128 个神经元时，在 10.3% 的保留提示中至少有一层的贡献可由稀疏神经元群解释；若要求至少四层参与，覆盖率降至 8.7%；若要求十二层，则为 3.3%。研究表明，现有神经元的小规模群体可作为跨提示可复用的计算组件，并且这类群体能够在大规模模型中被有效发现。

作者: Igor Shilov,Thomas Fel,Tal Haklay,Lucius Bushnaq,Owen Lewis
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:What reusable units of computation can we discover within a language model’s neurons? Prior work has shown that individual forward passes can often be sparsified post-hoc to small groups of neurons, but it has been unclear whether these groups form coherent computational entities reused across inputs. We introduce neuron community discovery, an unsupervised method for finding neuron groups that recur across prompts and are causally necessary and sufficient, within the layers they span, for common computations. The method combines gradient-based attribution, a graph connecting neurons that are repeatedly attributed together, and community detection. Applied to Llama-3.1-8B using ten million prompts, it discovers thousands of candidate communities. We evaluate them on held-out prompts through three causal tests: community necessity, sufficiency within a layer subset, and layer necessity. These tests identify groups whose removal disrupts predictions and whose retention preserves predictions despite ablating the remaining MLP neurons in the tested layers. Discovered communities support functions like grammatical agreement, token-probability calibration, fixed phrases, in-context copying, addition, and multiplication. With communities capped at 128 neurons across all layers, 10.3% of held-out prompts have at least one layer’s contribution explained on a neuron-sparse basis. Coverage remains 8.7% when requiring at least four layers and 3.3% when requiring at least twelve. These results show that small groups of existing neurons can provide reusable computational components across prompts, and that such groups can be discovered at scale.

[NLP-11] Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language Memory and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）背景下自然语言在计算系统中角色的根本性转变问题，即如何超越传统自然语言处理（NLP）中将语言视为被动处理对象的范式，重新定义语言作为可执行认知媒介的功能。其核心挑战在于：当大型语言模型（LLMs）使自然语言具备编程与推理能力时，如何理论化和建模人类与AI协作中的动态认知过程。解决方案的关键在于提出“自然语言编程”（Natural Language Programming, NLPg）这一新范式，将提示（prompt）视为动态的认知产物，不仅承载任务目标与约束条件，还外化了中间推理状态与验证标准。通过引入“对话式工作记忆”（Dialogic Working Memory）概念，论文将提示与对话状态建模为分布式人机记忆架构中的临时外部记忆结构，支持推理连续性与元认知调控。该框架整合了分布认知、扩展心智、元认知及对话学习等理论，并将现有记忆架构（如BTMA、SKGE、RMR）映射至该体系，揭示了情景、语义与元认知层如何协同支撑长时程对话连贯性。最终，论文推动计算语言学与人机知识系统进入后符号化、后界面的新范式，其中自然语言同时充当通信媒介、可执行规范、认知支架与分布式记忆架构。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23106
作者: Giovanni Adorni,Daniele Grosso
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows. This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures. Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence. Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.
