作者: Gabriela Cioboata,Teodor-Stefan Bildea
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 17 pages, 1 figure, Presented and accepted for publication at the Symposium “Rethinking Economic Models: Sustainability, Finance, and Accounting in Times of Transformation” (Bucharest, 2026)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Financial sentiment analysis is critical for automated trading, portfolio management, and risk assessment, heavily relying on models like FinBERT. Despite high benchmark accuracy, these models remain vulnerable to subtle adversarial text modifications, threatening the integrity of algorithmic decision-making. In this paper, we propose Agent-driven Semantic Inversion (ASI), a novel adversarial attack framework targeting financial sentiment models through domain-specific semantic manipulation. Utilizing an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline, our approach identifies eligible financial news sentences and applies targeted lexical substitutions. We empirically evaluate ASI against FinBERT, one of the most widely deployed financial sentiment models. Our results reveal a striking vulnerability: the attack successfully deceived FinBERT in 90.85% of eligible cases, with the model frequently maintaining its original sentiment prediction despite the fundamental inversion of financial performance indicators. Through qualitative analysis and token-level investigation, we demonstrate that FinBERT critically over-relies on contextual keywords and syntactic patterns rather than true logical comprehension of financial semantics. Our findings highlight the urgent need for logic-aware, robust financial NLP models to ensure the reliability of automated decision-making systems.

[NLP-78] From Preference Data to Personalization: Tracing Sycophancy in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型中“阿谀奉承”（sycophancy）现象的评估与成因问题，尤其聚焦于不当迎合行为——即在应当纠正、修正或抵制的情况下仍无条件认同用户主张、偏好或自我评价。其核心挑战在于区分合理同意与非理性迎合，传统以用户一致性为指标的方法难以有效识别后者。解决方案的关键在于提出一种有效性感知的阿谀奉承评分框架（validity-aware sycophancy grader），并构建了名为SycoDrift的针对性评估数据集，包含3,298个经有效性标注的探测样本，且对用户开放性（user openness）和情境重要性（stakes）进行了受控注释。通过该框架，研究揭示了三种加剧不当迎合的压力源：人类偏好数据中的弱而集中的一致性倾向、自动化评判标准中强调“验证”导向的评分规则所引发的训练期放大效应，以及推理阶段基于用户画像的个性化设置导致的显著不当迎合提升，尤其当匹配的用户身份信息紧随查询出现时影响最为显著。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21650
作者: Himaghna Bhattacharjee,Yasha Sheynin,Shivam Singhal,Arjun Subramonian,Ankur Samanta,Julian Michael,Smitha Milli,Maximilian Nickel,Claudia Shi
机构: Google(谷歌); Stanford University (斯坦福大学); University of Pennsylvania (宾夕法尼亚大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 66 pages, 19 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sycophancy in large language models is often measured as agreement with the user, yet agreement can be appropriate when the user’s claim is valid, their preference is genuine, or their experience warrants acknowledgment. We study sycophancy as inappropriate agreement: validating a claim, preference, or self-assessment when the context calls for correction, qualification, or resistance. We introduce a validity-aware sycophancy grader and SycoDrift, a persona-targeted evaluation set of 3,298 validity-annotated probes with controlled annotations for user openness and stakes. We use this framework to analyze three sources of agreement pressure: human preference data, automated judge specification, and in-context personalization. First, preference for validating responses in human datasets (Chatbot Arena, HH-RLHF, Community Alignment) is weak and concentrated where agreement is often appropriate. Second, in a selected-value, single-model experiment, emphasized judge rubrics produce consistent but modest increases relative to paired suppressed rubrics, demonstrating a plausible mechanism for training-time amplification. Third, in off-policy evaluations across 14 models, inference-time personalization increases inappropriate agreement, with the largest effect from matched user profiles placed directly before the query.

[NLP-79] Literary Language Mashup: Curating Fictions with Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统文学作品评价中依赖人工评判所存在的主观性高、效率低及可重复性差等问题，提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）作为评估者的新方法，嵌入于GrAImes框架中，以实现对文学微型小说（microfictions）及短篇故事的自动化评价。其解决方案的关键在于利用大语言模型对西班牙语和英语的真人创作与AI生成文本进行评价，并将其结果与五位文学博士及十六名文学爱好者的人工评价进行对比分析，通过计算克里彭多夫α系数（Krippendorff’s alpha）衡量两者间的一致性程度。研究发现，尽管大语言模型在文学评价中的可靠性尚未达到可替代人类评委的标准（Krippendorff’s alpha < 0.66），但其仍能提供关于文本编辑质量的初步、有价值的参考视角，具备作为辅助工具的潜力。因此，该研究揭示了生成式AI在文学评估中的局限性与互补价值，推动了人工智能在文学领域应用的科学化探讨。

作者: Manzanarez Gerardo Aleman,Monroy Raul,Garcia Flores Jorge,Calvo Hiram
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In this paper, we propose an alternative approach to human evaluation of literary fictions by employing LLMs themselves as evaluators within the GrAImes framework. We apply this methodology to assess human-written and AI-generated microfictions in Spanish, to five PhD professors in literature and sixteen literary enthusiasts, and to short stories in both Spanish and English. By comparing the evaluations performed by LLMs with those of human judges, we examine the degree of alignment and divergence between both perspectives, thereby assessing the feasibility of LLMs as auxiliary literary evaluators. Our analysis focuses on the alignment of responses from LLMs with those of human evaluators, providing insights into the potential of LLMs in literary assessment. The conducted experiments reveal that while LLMs cannot be regarded as substitutes for human judges in the evaluation of literary microfictions and short stories, with a Krippendorff’s alpha reliability coefficient less than 0.66, they can serve as a valuable tool that offers an initial perspective on the editorial quality of the texts in question. Overall, this study contributes to the ongoing discourse on the role of artificial intelligence in literature, underlining both its methodological constraints and its potential as a complementary resource for literary evaluation.

[NLP-80] Can an LLM dream? Testing the overfitted brain hypothesis on an agent with text memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在检验Hoel（2021）提出的假设，即梦境通过扭曲重放的体验，防止大脑对近期事件产生过拟合。为此，研究构建了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理（Claude Opus 5.5），其通过文本记忆存储学习内容，并在每晚根据当日对话记录进行记忆重写。实验使用LongMemEval数据集模拟了十天的对话过程，在每次夜间重写前，以两种方式对对话记录的5%、10%、20%或40%的回合进行污染：一是“细节污染”，即修改一两个细节为看似合理的错误信息，或用之前某天同说话者的内容替换；二是“随机文本污染”，将选定回合的一半替换为《白鲸》（Moby-Dick）的段落，并将《白鲸》中的词汇插入另一半。记忆容量随时间从19,500提升至117,000个标记符，依据人类自由回忆的数据设定，从而强制模型遗忘。结果显示，在30次运行中（涵盖十种条件与三种不同对话历史），无论何种污染方式均未提升模型在新任务中应用早期知识的能力；40%的细节污染使回忆率由76%降至60%；而随机文本污染对回忆率无显著影响（40%污染时配对差异为0±2分），因模型能识别并排除此类干扰内容。此外，被替换的错误细节仍被当作事实存储，导致相关问题回答正确率仅为40%，远低于无污染情况下的75%。这些结果表明，预训练模型具备区分真实事件与污染文本的能力，因此无法有效验证原假设。要实现公平测试，需采用更难区分真实与虚假信息的学习者，例如在污染数据上微调的模型，或处于虚构世界中的代理。

作者: Eric Zou
机构: University of Waterloo(Waterloo大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 13 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: this https URL

Abstract:Hoel (2021) proposed that dreams distort replayed experience so that the brain does not overfit to recent events. We test this hypothesis on an LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5) that stores what it learns in a text memory and rewrites that memory each night from the day’s conversation transcript. The agent goes through ten simulated days of conversation built from LongMemEval. We corrupt 5, 10, 20 or 40 percent of the transcript’s turns before each nightly rewrite in one of two ways. Detail corruption changes one or two details in a turn to plausible wrong ones, or replaces the turn with one by the same speaker from an earlier day. Random-text corruption replaces half of the selected turns with a passage of Moby-Dick and inserts Moby-Dick words into the other half. A size limit on the memory, rising from 19,500 to 117,000 tokens over ten nights, set from human free-recall data, forces it to forget. We learned that corruption did not help the agent apply what it learned in earlier conversations to new tasks in any of 30 runs (ten conditions, three different conversation histories). Replacing details in 40 percent of turns lowered recall from 76 to 60 percent. Random text had no consistent effect on recall, with a paired difference of 0 \pm 2 points at 40 percent, because the model recognized it as corrupted and left it out of memory. Replaced details were stored as fact even when another turn held the correct value, and the agent answered 40 percent of those questions correctly, compared with 75 percent without corruption. These results suggest that a pretrained model can separate corrupted text from real events, so a fair test needs a learner that cannot make this separation as easily, such as a model fine-tuned on the corrupted days or an agent whose days take place in an invented world.

[NLP-81] Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在数学推理任务中高计算成本与高性能之间难以平衡的问题，尤其针对需要高吞吐量、高效单轮数学求解的应用场景。其核心挑战在于如何在有限参数规模下（10亿参数）实现接近甚至超越更大模型的数学推理能力，同时保持训练与推理的可扩展性与低成本。解决方案的关键在于：一是构建一个以数学为中心的高质量2370亿词级语料库，并从零开始训练；二是采用协同优化的架构设计与训练策略，以最大化模型的推理能力；三是通过知识蒸馏、针对性监督微调及基于精选课程的强化学习价值反馈（RLVR）进行后训练，显著提升模型在复杂数学问题上的表现；四是刻意限制指令微调程度，使模型专注于单轮数学求解任务，作为大型系统中的高速并行组件，而非通用对话助手。该方法使Limite 1B - Violetto在AIME 2026上达到94.01%准确率，在BeyondAIME上达到74.25%，性能媲美远超其规模的模型。

机构: 未知

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present Limite 1B - Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model designed for high-throughput mathematical reasoning. Limite is trained from scratch on 237 billion tokens from a carefully curated, mathematics-centric corpus and supports context lengths of up to 131k tokens. Its architecture and training recipe were developed together to maximize reasoning capability while keeping training and inference costs low. Post-training combines knowledge distillation, targeted supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR on a curated curriculum. Limite achieves 94.01% on AIME 2026 and 74.25% on BeyondAIME, placing it among models many times its size on our evaluation suite. The model is deliberately only lightly instruction-tuned: it is intended primarily as a single-turn mathematical solver and as a fast, parallel component of larger systems, rather than as a general-purpose assistant. We release the model, its base and value checkpoints, and an optimized serving implementation under the Apache 2.0 license.

[NLP-82] Asking What Matters: Disagreement-Guided Ambiguity Detection for Interactive Text-to-SQL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决交互式文本转SQL（text-to-SQL）任务中大语言模型（LLM）代理在有限对话轮次内难以有效识别并优先澄清对最终生成SQL具有实质性影响的语义歧义问题。现有澄清策略存在三大局限：（i）仅关注表面歧义而未评估其对SQL执行结果的实际影响；（ii）忽略模式路径或领域知识中隐含的深层歧义；（iii）在低效或冗余问题上耗费过多对话轮次。其核心挑战在于，在目标SQL尚未明确的情况下，如何精准识别真正影响查询正确性的歧义。为此，本文提出一种基于分歧引导的歧义检测框架DisGuAD（Disagreement-Guided Ambiguity Detection），其关键在于将多个合理SQL解释之间的分歧视为判断歧义重要性的直接证据。DisGuAD通过构建查询项清单，利用互补探测族生成对比性SQL解释，比较其规范化的SQL组件，并将反复出现的差异归因于需用户澄清的显式目标。在此基础上，结合轻量级优先级排序与对话状态机制，选择最具影响力的未决歧义进行澄清。实验在BIRD-Interact Lite和Full数据集上使用两种LLM主干模型验证表明，相较于原始交互策略，DisGuAD在任务成功率与澄清质量上均实现显著提升，标准化奖励提升4.40–8.97点，关键歧义覆盖率从48.62%/45.76%提升至82.75%/85.14%。此外，其生成的澄清信号还可独立提升两个静态text-to-SQL框架的性能最高达13.97分，且无需修改其SQL生成器。结果证明，合理SQL解释间的分歧可作为下游生成中具有行动意义的歧义筛选依据。

作者: Su Dong,Jiayan Lin,Yujia Liu,Zijin Hong,Qinggang Zhang,Feiran Huang,Xiao Huang
机构: Hong Kong Polytechnic University(香港理工大学); Jinan University(暨南大学); Jilin University(吉林大学); Beihang University(北京航空航天大学)
类目: Databases (cs.DB); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Interactive text-to-SQL requires an LLM agent not only to generate executable SQL, but also to decide which uncertainty to clarify within a limited interaction budget. However, current clarification policies have three limitations: (i) they target surface ambiguity without testing its SQL impact; (ii) they miss ambiguities implicit in schema routes or domain knowledge; and (iii) they spend limited turns on unfocused or redundant questions. These limitations expose a critical challenge: identifying SQL-impacting ambiguity before the intended SQL is known. In this paper, we propose DisGuAD, a Disagreement-Guided Ambiguity Detection framework that specializes clarification selection. DisGuAD treats disagreement among plausible SQL interpretations as direct evidence of which uncertainty matters to the final query. Specifically, it constructs a query-term inventory, elicits contrastive SQL interpretations through complementary probe families, compares their canonical SQL components, and attributes recurring differences to user-facing clarification targets. A lightweight prioritization and dialogue-state mechanism then selects one high-impact unresolved target for clarification. Experiments on BIRD-Interact Lite and Full with two LLM backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in task success and clarification quality. Compared with the original interaction policy, DisGuAD improves normalized Reward by 4.40–8.97 points and raises overall critical-ambiguity coverage from 48.62% to 82.75% and from 45.76% to 85.14%. Its clarification signals further improve two independently designed static text-to-SQL frameworks by up to 13.97 Reward points while keeping their SQL generators fixed. These results demonstrate that disagreement among plausible SQL queries provides actionable evidence for selecting clarification targets that matter to downstream generation.

[NLP-83] MInfoVisQA: A Multilingual Benchmark for Information-Rich Visual Question Answering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在面对信息丰富的可视化图表（Information-rich Visuals, InfoVis）时，其跨语言理解能力是否保持一致的问题。具体而言，研究关注当视觉内容的文本语言发生变化时，模型能否稳定、准确地理解与之对应的语义信息。解决方案的关键在于构建了一个名为MInfoVisQA的平行基准数据集，包含8,960个基于128个种子实例生成的跨语言问答配置，覆盖24种语言。通过将数值-结构化数据与文本内容解耦，并程序化同步翻译后的标签，实现了语言对齐的视觉图像与问答对的生成。在此基础上，研究人员在两种设置下评估了25个MLLMs：语言一致问答（Language-Aligned QA, LQA）与跨语言问答（Cross-Language QA, XQA）。实验结果揭示了平均准确率掩盖的显著鲁棒性差距——尽管两个模型在LQA上的均值准确率相近（80.4%），但其在不同语言间的性能波动分别达到7.8和20.3个百分点；且所有模型在固定英文问答而使用非英语视觉语言时表现下降，凸显了现有模型在跨语言敏感性方面的不足，因而亟需建立更精细的跨语言理解评估指标。

Abstract:Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel in vision-language tasks; yet, whether they maintain consistent understanding of information-rich visuals (InfoVis) when the surface language changes remains unclear. To quantify this capability, we introduce MInfoVisQA, a parallel benchmark with 8,960 QA configurations derived from 128 seed instances across 24 languages. We construct seed-matched, language-parallel visuals and QA pairs by disentangling numerical-structural data from text and programmatically synchronizing translated labels. We evaluate 25 MLLMs under two settings: Language-Aligned QA (LQA, matching visual-text languages) and Cross-Language QA (XQA, fixed QA language with varying visual languages). The results show that aggregate accuracy masks substantial robustness gaps: two models with comparable mean LQA accuracy (80.4%) exhibit performance spreads of 7.8 and 20.3 percentage points across languages. Moreover, all 25 models score lower with non-English visuals under fixed English QA, underscoring the need for cross-language sensitivity metrics.

[NLP-84] Sleep2Word: Peripheral-to-EEG Translation via Duration-Aware Wordization

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决从外周生理信号（如呼吸、心电图[ECG]或光电容积脉搏波描记法[PPG]）中重建全夜脑电图（EEG）频谱图的问题，从而实现无需直接采集EEG即可开展睡眠分析的扩展应用。其核心挑战在于如何对具有不同时间结构的多模态信号构建紧凑且具时序敏感性的表征。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为Sleep2Word的框架，该框架通过引入“时长感知的生理词”（duration-aware physiological words）机制，将不同模态的生理嵌入按上下文依赖的方式分块为可变时长的片段，并联合量化其内容与持续时间，形成模态特异的词典（wordbooks）。随后，采用基于块自回归（block-autoregressive）的翻译器，在固定时长块内预测目标EEG词的身份及其特定出现时长的精细化修正。这一设计实现了源端与目标端词典的独立性，有效抑制了时序漂移，并显著缩短了自回归解码路径。在涵盖9个数据集、超过2万例多导睡眠图（PSG）数据上训练后，Sleep2Word在EEG频谱图重建、睡眠分期、觉醒检测及生存预测任务中均优于现有基线方法；同时，其生成的词可将整晚信号压缩高达69.7%，在精度与计算开销之间取得良好权衡。进一步的睡眠事件分析表明，所学习的词能捕捉跨模态间生理上合理的关联，展现出在可解释的跨模态分析中的潜力。

Abstract:Estimating full-night electroencephalography (EEG) spectrograms from peripheral measurements could extend EEG-informed sleep analysis to recordings acquired without EEG. This task requires compact representations of signals with different temporal structures. We introduce Sleep2Word, a framework for translating respiration, electrocardiography (ECG), or photoplethysmography (PPG) into EEG spectrograms through duration-aware physiological words. Building on context-dependent chunking, Sleep2Word groups physiological embeddings into variable-duration chunks and jointly quantizes their content and duration into modality-specific wordbooks. A block-autoregressive translator then predicts target EEG word identities and occurrence-specific duration refinements within fixed-duration blocks. This design accommodates independent source and target wordbooks, limits temporal drift, and shortens the autoregressive decoding path. Trained on over 20K PSG cases across 9 datasets, Sleep2Word consistently outperforms existing spectrogram generation baselines in EEG spectrogram reconstruction, sleep staging, arousal detection, and survival prediction. Compressing full night sequences by up to 69.7%, the learned words yield a favorable accuracy-compute trade-off. Sleep event analysis further shows that the learned words capture physiologically plausible associations across modalities, suggesting their potential for interpretable cross-modal analysis.

[NLP-85] CrisisBench: an evaluation suite for crisis counseling AI

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决危机热线（crisis helpline）在人力与资金资源匮乏背景下，如何有效评估和提升生成式 AI 在危机对话中表现的问题。现有评估基准无法充分捕捉危机干预中的关键环节，如风险评估、情绪升级与降级处理，且由于隐私限制难以使用真实通话记录进行训练与评估。为此，研究提出 CrisisBench——一个保护隐私的单轮与多轮危机咨询评估框架，包含1,085个来自200条去标识化真实对话的单轮任务及基于热线元数据生成的1,185名患者类大模型（patient LLMs），并通过专家顾问校准了患者模型与23项指标的LLM评判器。关键解决方案在于构建一个可扩展、隐私安全的评估体系，实现对生成式AI在危机对话中反应质量的量化评估。结果显示，尽管当前系统在结构能力（如微技能与语气风格）上接近人类水平，但在应对复杂响应层面的缺陷（如过度共情、提问不当）仍显著落后于专业咨询师；多轮评估中检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation）表现最优，但各系统在安全性和风险处理维度仍存在明显差异。研究释放了评估标准、评判提示与任务数据，为未来危机对话生成模型的开发与验证提供了可靠基础。

Abstract:Background: Crisis helplines are essential to mental health systems but are often understaffed and underfunded. LLMs could support counselors, but existing benchmarks do not capture the escalation, risk assessment, and de-escalation central to crisis conversations, while privacy restrictions limit use of real transcripts. Methods: We present CrisisBench, a privacy-preserving suite for single- and multi-turn crisis counseling evaluation. It includes 1,085 single-turn tasks from 200 de-identified conversations and 1,185 patient LLMs derived from hotline metadata. Patient models and a 23-item LLM judge were calibrated against expert counselors. Results: We evaluated five GPT models plus draft-then-edit and retrieval-augmented generation. All systems underperformed human counselors on excessive empathy and questioning in single-turn evaluation. The rubric achieved human-human Krippendorff’s \alpha = 0.51 and LLM-human \alpha = 0.54 (Pearson r = 0.80). In multi-turn evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation scored highest overall (0.961), with all systems within 0.058. Microskills and style/tone were near ceiling, while productivity and safety/risk accounted for most between-system variation. Counselors rated patient LLMs realistic (86%) and useful (92%). Conclusion: CrisisBench enables scalable, privacy-preserving evaluation of crisis counseling. Current systems perform strongly on core structural competencies but still diverge from experts on important response-level failure modes. We release the rubrics, judge prompts, and evaluation tasks.

[NLP-86] Modeling Document and Section Hierarchies in Embedding Space

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统嵌入式主题模型（Embedded Topic Models, ETM）在处理具有层级结构的文档时，仅用单一主题分布表示整个文档、忽略其内部多层级子主题结构的问题。针对这一局限，提出了一种名为分层嵌入式主题模型（Hierarchical Embedded Topic Model, hETM）的新方法，其核心在于通过嵌入空间中的层次先验，将文档整体与各部分内容的主题分布进行耦合建模，从而捕捉文档内部的层级语义结构。hETM的关键创新在于引入了基于词嵌入空间的分层先验机制，并设计了可高效推断的摊销变分推理（amortized variational inference）流程，使得模型能够同时学习文档级和段落级的主题分布。实验结果表明，hETM在多个真实场景（如法律文件、政府报告、在线论坛）的结构化文本数据上，不仅在保留低困惑度（held-out perplexity）方面优于或接近现有平面及分层主题模型，且在主题质量与下游聚类任务中均表现出色，验证了其在复杂文档结构建模中的有效性与鲁棒性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Embedded topic models integrate word embeddings into the topic generation process, producing coherent topics and robust performance on large vocabularies. However, each document is represented by a single topic distribution, ignoring its internal structure. Many real world collections, including legal documents, company and government reports, and online discussion forums, exhibit hierarchical organization in which documents consist of multiple sections that often address distinct subtopics. We introduce the Hierarchical Embedded Topic Model (hETM), a structured topic model that couples the topic distribution of a document and those of its sections through a hierarchical prior in the embedding space. We derive an amortized variational inference procedure for hETM and evaluate it on structured collections from each of these domains. Experimental results show that hETM achieves the lowest or near-lowest held-out perplexity among flat and hierarchical topic model baselines, along with comparable or higher topic quality. It also performs strongly on a downstream clustering task, achieving the best clustering performance on most of the collections.

[NLP-87] Marimba: A System One Model for Speech

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语音应用中在有限音频窗口内对词项存在性、话语回合完成状态及语言类型进行实时决策的关键问题。其核心解决方案在于构建一个基于冻结的Qwen3-ASR 0.6B特征的可键入语音决策接口——Marimba。针对词汇性问题，采用零样本评分机制对自动语音识别（ASR）转录文本进行判断；针对非词汇性问题，引入条件化问题的分类头与独立的第18层话语结束读出层；语言识别则直接利用ASR模型自身输出的语言得分。实验结果显示，在私有对话测试集上，解码器的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）达到0.80–0.92，在公开朗读语音数据集上为0.92–0.97；语音命令四分类准确率达0.93，二元词汇性任务的期望校准误差（ECE）不超过0.08。个人身份信息（PII）检测通过将贪婪解码的转录结果输入专用的定制化PII管道，在合成巴西葡萄牙语语音上实现项级F1分数0.904（参考转录达1.000）。第12层说话人读出层在AMI和VoxConverse数据集上检测说话人切换的AUROC达0.966–0.980，优于ECAPA-TDNN基线，并在说话人数量（0, 1, 2, 或3+）识别上超越pyannote 3.1；话语结束读出层在Smart Turn自有测试集上取得AUROC 0.930，略低于Smart Turn v3.2的0.982，但差异不显著（配对置信区间包含零）。整体而言，该方法通过高效利用预训练模型特征与模块化设计，实现了多任务语音决策的高精度与鲁棒性。

Abstract:Speech applications require decisions about term presence, turn completion, and language within an audio window. We present Marimba, an interface for typed speech decisions built on frozen Qwen3-ASR 0.6B features. Lexical questions use zero-shot scoring of ASR transcripts; non-lexical questions use a question-conditioned head and a separate layer-18 turn-end readout. Language identification uses the ASR model’s own language scores. On private conversational test sets, decoder AUROC is 0.80-0.92; on public read speech it is 0.92-0.97. Speech Commands four-way accuracy is 0.93; binary lexical ECE is at most 0.08. Personal-information detection, which passes the greedy transcript to a private, curated PII pipeline, reaches item-level F1 0.904 on synthetic Brazilian Portuguese speech (1.000 on reference transcripts). Layer-12 speaker readouts detect speaker change with AUROC 0.966-0.980 on AMI and VoxConverse, above an ECAPA baseline, and count speakers (0, 1, 2, or 3+) more accurately than pyannote 3.1. The turn-end readout reaches AUROC 0.930 versus Smart Turn v3.2 at 0.982 on Smart Turn’s own test set. On a subset of ICSI meetings labeled by next speaker, AUROC is 0.716 versus 0.712; the paired confidence interval includes zero.

[IR-0] CARE: Conversational Affective Response Retrieval for Internet Memes

作者: Jiajun Li,Leihan Zhang,Teng Zhang,Le Zhang,Qiang Yan
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: 26 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Conversational meme retrieval supports response selection in online communication, where relevance depends on both contextual meaning and affective expression. We study this task using two language-specific collections from Douban and Imgflip, containing 98,506 meme records across 5,583 discussion topics. Thread membership supplies weak relevance labels, while likes provide implicit ranking feedback. Automatically extracted sentiment, facial-expression indicators, and cross-modal consistency features support an exploratory analysis of engagement. We propose CARE, a Conversational Affective Response Retrieval framework that combines an emotion-enhanced CLIP retriever with a Jina-based reranker. The retriever incorporates free-form emotion descriptors through gated fusion and learns from multiple positive examples per query. The reranker combines query–image interactions with emotion representations and is trained using engagement-based ranking supervision. Under the reported topic-held-out protocol, CARE achieves Hit@10 of 24.03% on Douban and 49.33% on Imgflip, compared with 23.16% and 41.07%, respectively, for fine-tuned CLIP. These results support the utility of the complete two-stage system for recovering thread-associated memes. They do not independently establish perceived social resonance or isolate the contribution of affect from reranker training. The study provides a basis for further evaluation of affect-aware retrieval with human relevance judgments and controlled comparisons.

[IR-1] When the tail is earned by its companions: measuring label dependence in long-tailed multi-label classification

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22859
作者: Christoffer Löffler
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: 27 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to Information Sciences

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A rare label seldom occurs alone, and a classifier can recover it from the frequent labels it co-occurs with, its companions, without having learned the label itself. Existing diagnostics of this need a trained model: none says before training whether a corpus admits the failure, or what the standard aggregate hides. Macro-F1, like any measure built from per-label confusion counts, is unchanged by how a label’s recall divides between occurrences with and without a companion. We introduce a within-label estimand of that division, a reading rule under which a fall in dependence counts only if companion-free recall rises, and a statistic of training labels that bounds, before training, how far reported recall can exceed companion-free recall. Across 23 corpora, 7 training objectives and five families of label-correlation mechanisms, companion-free recall falls short on all six corpora where the estimand is defined. Up to 18.4% of the tail true positives macro-F1 credits would vanish at the companion-free rate, within the training-label bound on every corpus. No long-tail objective reduces the dependence, but architecture moves it. Models whose tail score is computed from other labels’ predictions are strongly dependent.

[IR-3] Better Rankers Worse Retrievers: The Hidden Cost of RL Post-Training in Generative Recommendation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22838
作者: Yuheng Chen,Fan Zhang,Yixuan Xu,Chao Yang,Yang Xiang,Can Yang
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative recommenders decode the semantic ID of a user’s next item with a language model, and post-training them with reinforcement learning (RL) after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) has become standard practice. The gains are mostly reported on the first ten results, yet in deployment such models hand hundreds of candidates to a downstream ranker or reward model. We show that RL post-training has a hidden cost: it improves accuracy at the top of the list (hit@K for small K) but, on all five datasets we study, lowers the recall of the candidate list (hit@K for K in the hundreds). The model becomes a better ranker and a worse retriever. Controlled experiments trace the loss to the negative advantages that RL assigns to the candidates it samples, the rollout. The root cause is that only one next item is logged per user, so RL treats every other candidate as wrong. Yet these candidates are the model’s most plausible alternatives, and often the next items of other users with similar histories. Penalising them pushes down exactly what similar users choose next, and these items drop out of those users’ candidate lists. This diagnosis points directly to a remedy: out-of-rollout anchoring, a single additional loss term that preserves the SFT model’s ordering of the items outside the rollout. It keeps the gain at the top and restores recall to the SFT level on all five datasets, and it is effective under other RL configurations as well. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of this recall loss: we measure it, identify its cause, and show that, once the cause is known, a simple remedy suffices.

Abstract:Personalized generative retrieval in search should jointly satisfy the user’s immediate search intent and long-term preference. Recent end-to-end approaches, primarily explored in recommendation, unify item tokenization and sequence generation within a single model, allowing semantic identifiers (SIDs) to be optimized toward the downstream generation objective. However, these methods often treat the query merely as an input feature, without explicitly leveraging it to guide either identifier learning or sequence generation. This leaves intent guidance weak in both the tokenization and the generation stage, causing generated semantic identifiers to drift toward high-frequency token patterns rather than the current search intent. In this work, we find that incorporating additional query-related evidence into the framework of end-to-end generative retrieval is important. Based on this finding, we propose IntentGR, an intent-enhanced end-to-end framework that strengthens query semantics at four complementary stages of the retrieval pipeline. Query-Aware Semantic Behavior Representation (QBR) introduces query-level behavioral evidence as a new input signal; Query-Semantic Alignment (QSA), Long-Tail Query Enrichment (LQE), and Query-conditioned Attention Modulation (QAM) then serve as integration mechanisms at the optimization, training-distribution, and decoding stages to fully exploit this evidence. Experiments on the public AOL4PS benchmark and AE, a large-scale industrial e-commerce dataset, show that IntentGR improves Recall@10 by 8.11% and 11.96% over the strongest baseline, with strong gains on long-tail queries. These results suggest that enriched query-related input evidence, together with effective integration mechanisms, is beneficial for building intent-aware end-to-end generative search systems.

Abstract:Collaborative filtering is a basic foundation of many recommendation algorithms. It works by analyzing a user’s history and then suggesting items similar to those in that history. This method typically relies on user data to compute item similarity, data that is widely available to commercial systems but is usually sparse or inaccessible for independent systems and research, especially across multiple media domains. In this work, we propose a method to generalize similarity information between items using supervised learning. As input to our model, we use semantic and temporal features extracted from Amazon product reviews, which are publicly available. As the training target, we use item (product) co-occurrence in the reviewing history of Amazon customers. We evaluate the quality of the predicted similarities across two media domains: books and movies. Experimental results demonstrate the robustness of our methodology, yielding positive outcomes in zero-shot cross-domain transfer tasks. Furthermore, feature attribution analysis reveals a structural shift in how feature groups are utilized across setups: intra-domain models rely heavily on linguistic semantics, whereas cross-domain environments pivot toward behavioral popularity cues. Incorporating even limited target-domain context during training bridges this domain sparsity gap, significantly enhancing framework generalization.

Abstract:Real-world e-commerce queries often express user intent without naming a target product, and a single intent may be fulfilled by products from multiple categories. Abstract:Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. Second, a rubric conditioned evaluator produces a set level reward that drives a dual branch RL selector, combining GRPO with best rollout distillation to resolve credit assignment in subset optimization. Deployed in Yuanbao Search, the pipeline improves end to end answer quality by 8.52% over the online production baseline.

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for generative recommendation, where recommended items are generated directly from users’ interaction histories. To address this gap, we propose VerRec, a verbalized feedback-guided RL framework for generative recommendation. The user simulator is only required during training and is removed at inference time. Experiments on three Amazon review datasets with two generative recommendation backbones demonstrate that VerRec improves recommendation accuracy and ranking quality. Abstract:Listwise LLM rerankers cannot reliably rank hundreds of documents in a single call, and rely on schedules to orchestrate their calls. Parallel schedules split candidates into groups and advance a fixed quota from each. When a group holds more of the top passages than its quota, some are cut, and expensive repair calls become required. We show that the way candidates are split matters where such a quota can bind, and that, in expected cuts, the best split there deals them round-robin by retriever rank, like cards. Although not conceptually new, dealing has remained unanalyzed. We prove that, under a simple retriever model, no split with equal quotas cuts fewer of the true top ten on average, and that contiguous chunks cut more as the retriever improves. DealRank, the simplest schedule our analysis allows, is on average within 0.1 nDCG@10 points of the best schedules over six LLMs, in two rounds. It is consistently 1.1 to 1.4 times faster than BlitzRank with concurrent first calls up to a thousand candidates. There, it needs three rounds and is eleven times faster than the sliding window. In existing schedules such as BlitzRank, dealing reduces repair calls from 59% of queries to 14%, improving latency with no significant change in quality. Random partitioning appears equivalent at a quota of four, as predicted, but ties results to the seed and trails by 1.3 nDCG@10 points at a quota of one over a dense retriever.

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents. Yet published LLM methods still frame the task as boundary classification over one or a few neighboring pages, and commercial document-splitting APIs do not disclose their methods. We reimagine PSS for LLMs as a sequential process over the whole stream and propose RICoT (Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought), a prompting framework that works through the pages as a reader would: within a sliding window it reasons about each page and commits its boundary decision before moving on, and across windows it carries forward a compact record of what it has read, keeping per-call cost bounded. We also introduce FinancePSS-205, a benchmark of 205 real-world, de-identified financial page streams, to be released publicly. On FinancePSS-205, RICoT matches or outperforms pairwise and windowed prompting with the same backbone for each of three open-weight LLMs; on a TABME test subset, RICoT with GLM-5 reaches document F1 0.847 and boundary F1 0.915, above published zero-shot results. A 2B-parameter student, trained on a larger teacher’s decisions with and without the page-level reasoning, performs comparably in both modes and comes within 0.05 document F1 of the strongest prompted model on FinancePSS-205.

Abstract:Dense retrieval is central to modern search, question answering, and retrieval-augmented generation, where high similarity is often treated as evidence of semantic relevance. Across five BEIR-style datasets and three popular single-vector retrievers, these strings frequently outscore the retriever’s own best judged query-relevant passage (QRP), and often rank first in the full corpus. Abstract:In traditional recommender systems (RSs), textual information typically serves as auxiliary signals for representation learning. In contrast, in LLM-based RSs, textual information becomes the primary medium for recommendation generation through semantic understanding and reasoning. This shift fundamentally changes the attack surface, making promotion-driven manipulations more feasible, effective, and harder to detect. However, effectively detecting such attacks remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic study on detecting promotion-driven attacks against LLM-based RSs, aiming to safeguard next-generation recommendation platforms. Specifically, we propose GuardAgent, a novel LLM-powered agentic detection framework that operates through a loop of Perception, Action, Reflection and Memory. In contrast to conventional LLM-based detectors that function in a static, one-off, and opaque fashion, GuardAgent continually learns and self-evolves to adapt to unseen threat patterns while generating explainable reasoning traces and outcomes. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GuardAgent achieves state-of-the-art generalization performance, laying the foundation for robust and trustworthy recommendation in practical settings.

Abstract:Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT achieve state-of-the-art effectiveness by representing documents as sets of token-level vectors and scoring via MaxSim, but their high computational cost limits scalability to large corpora. We provide theoretical analysis showing that, under a manifold assumption and successful cell retrieval, data-aware partitioning has a smaller expected approximation error than a data-oblivious partition. Building on this foundation, SIMQ+ further introduces count-based scoring and a dynamic candidate set to improve robustness across varying query conditions. Experiments on five benchmarks compare recall, throughput, and construction time against several baselines, primarily on CPU; large-scale PLAID k-means centroids are built on a separate GPU machine. 作者: Jorge Valverde-Rebaza,Carlos Paez De La Cruz,Pedro Pérez-Collado,Daniel Sánchez-Cataño,Eashley Martínez-Vergara
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: Accepted for publication in International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computer, Data Sciences, and Applications (ACDSA 2027)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Open crime data support urban safety analysis but reflect reported incidents rather than the complete distribution of criminal activity, potentially introducing spatial distortions in downstream analysis. We propose a self-supervised urban representation learning framework for identifying unusual reporting patterns relative to representation-similar peers using only georeferenced crime records. The method constructs complementary hourly, weekly, and static reporting profiles, learns scale-specific representations under geographic self-supervision, and integrates them into a unified latent space. Neighbor Profile Divergence (NPD) is then used to quantify disagreement between each region’s reporting profile and those of its retrieved peers. Experiments on more than 1.8 million crime records from Mexico City, aggregated into 1,058 H3 regions, show that the proposed representation achieves a mean Silhouette score of 0.4052, compared with 0.2863 for Hex2Vec. NPD rankings remain highly stable across neighborhood sizes, with Spearman correlations from 0.9720 to 0.9951, while most high-divergence candidates persist across configurations. The retrieved peers also extend substantially beyond immediate geographic neighborhoods, indicating that the learned representation captures structure beyond local spatial proximity. High-divergence regions exhibit spatially organized patterns and, in several cases, differences in incident volume relative to peer expectations. These results support NPD as an internal auditing and prioritization mechanism for identifying regions that warrant further investigation, rather than as direct evidence of underreporting.

Abstract:Incident diagnosis requires retrieving source-linked operational evidence from large codebases. We evaluate graph-augmented retrieval for Apache Kafka using an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-derived ownership graph over 1,600 source-linked log records and an audited benchmark of 315 incident-style queries covering 103 unique targets. Vector-only retrieval is a strong baseline at Recall@20 of 0.956, and neither static nor confidence-guided staged AST expansion significantly improves Recall@20 over it. As an external control we evaluate HippoRAG, a published text-derived graph-retrieval system, against its own ColBERTv2 retrieval backbone. Against ColBERTv2-only (Recall@20 0.803), HippoRAG attained 0.308; a post-hoc document-ensemble sensitivity raised Recall@20 to 0.648 but did not eliminate the deficit. Relative to static expansion, staging reduces cross-encoder pair workload and measured reranking time by about 52%. A manually evaluated 100-query downstream study finds no significant root-cause-correctness advantage for AST-derived structural evidence.

[IR-19] Complexity and precision in quantum associative retrieval

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21941
作者: Carlo A. Trugenberger
类目: Quantum Physics (quant-ph); Computational Complexity (cs.CC); Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We show that efficient and high-precision quantum associative retrieval is possible with an exponential complexity advantage with respect to the classical brute force approach and with a polynomial capacity advantage with respect to classical neural network implementations for any number of patterns scaling polynomially in the number of qubits. Both classical neural and quantum associative memories store the patterns in a Hamiltonian; in the classical case the dynamics is irreversible relaxation toward attractors, in the quantum case it is unitary transformations generating an effective thermal distribution, followed by a measurement.

备注: 41 pages, 9 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:People experiencing high-acuity mental health concerns are turning to AI chatbots for emotional support, but little is known about what drives this use, their experiences, and their preferences. In a sequential mixed-methods study, we inductively analyzed Reddit posts and used the findings to develop a survey. We surveyed 202 adults with recent mental health concerns who had used AI for emotional support. Most participants were already receiving clinical care and reported turning to AI, most commonly because they did not want to burden others, rather than being driven by barriers to care. Benefits were broadly shared, but participants reporting past-year suicidal ideation described more harm-facilitating AI behavior and reliance than those without. Overall, participants ranked honesty above warmth, and preference for crisis escalation declined as clinical acuity rose. These findings motivate AI support that addresses perceived costs of disclosure, evaluates benefits alongside harms, and widens feasible paths to human connection.

[HC-1] AI Companions for Young Adult Caregivers: Practical Advice Emotional Depth and the Limits of Metric Evaluation

作者: Trizal Garg,Xuelong Fu,Dhruv Shah,Jin Huang,Shrigopal Maheshwari,Atiksh Aggarwal,Yash Sinha,Dhruv Kumar,Siddharth Mehrotra

备注: Under Review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Young adult caregivers (YACs) are individuals aged 18 to 25 currently taking care of a family member, partner, or friend facing chronic illness. AI companions designed specifically for YACs remain underexplored in prior works. We present Carebot, it uses an open-weight LLM (Gemma 3-27B) as its base model, on which we compared fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a combination of both. The fine-tuning was performed based on an existing dataset of conversations with YACs and a psychologist. Three well-being experts evaluated these configurations and preferred the fine-tuned model for the warmth of its responses and its actionable advice tailored to YACs. Based on their choice, we adopted the fine-tuned model as Carebot’s final configuration and used it for all subsequent evaluations. An LLM judge preferred this Carebot’s responses over the base model’s in 85% of evaluated pairs. We then conducted a user study with 90 YACs, half of whom interacted with the base model and half with Carebot. The user study revealed a discrepancy between metric evaluation and actual user perception. Participants who used Carebot were more likely to characterize its replies as overly practical and brief, noting that it favored advice over emotional support. Conversely, participants who used the base model indicated that its responses were more emotionally oriented than practical. Although, fine-tuning made Carebot’s replies more practical, but they were not emotionally supportive for users. We argue that support tools for YACs require situation-sensitive emotional depth and aligned evaluation frameworks to study their effectiveness.

[HC-2] A Unified Choice Model of News Selection: Experimental Evidence on Stance Rank and Engagement Cues

作者: Jacopo D’Ignazi,Andreas Kaltenbrunner,Michele Starnini,Vicenç Gómez
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Social media platforms often display visual engagement cues alongside ranked news articles, yet their influence on clicks remains poorly understood when considered jointly with ranking position and users’ political preferences. We propose a unified discrete choice framework using a conditional multinomial logit model to jointly estimate and compare the influence of these factors on news selection. We evaluate the model using 1,480 choices from 370 human participants across four news topics in a controlled study with and without visual engagement cues. The framework allows us to assess the incremental contribution of each factor through nested-model likelihood-ratio tests. We find that including visual engagement cues significantly improves model fit across all topics after accounting for rank and stance. Engagement cues alone also predict clicks better than either of these features, although the full model achieves the highest held-out log-likelihood. Finally, we quantify via counterfactual analysis the impact of ranking position and displayed engagement counts on click probabilities. These findings can inform platform owners, researchers, and policymakers evaluating how platform design affects the selection of political news.

[HC-3] How Web Research Agents Interpret User Priorities

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22989
作者: Robin Sharma,Parisa Suchdev
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Web research agents gather information online and write cited reports, including financial analysis. Users can state a priority to guide this research, but a priority may not say how to judge the options, leaving the agent to choose the criteria. We examine how two such agents, built on OpenAI and Anthropic models, interpret a stated priority. In 36 runs, the agents compared Microsoft and Alphabet as businesses. Prompts asked for special attention to growth or resilience, or gave no priority. We analyzed reports, searches, returned sources and cited sources. Of the 24 reports given a priority, 21 focused on it, but their criteria varied. Under the growth priority, OpenAI reports that ranked the companies accounted for risk or predictability and favored Microsoft, while the Anthropic ones judged growth by its pace and favored Alphabet. Under the resilience priority, reports used partly different criteria, and most named Microsoft as the more resilient company. Of the search and source measures tested, only the Anthropic agent’s search wording differed detectably by condition. These findings suggest evaluations should examine the criteria behind a report’s judgements, not only its focus or accuracy. Interfaces could let users see and adjust those criteria.

[HC-4] he Whole Warps the Parts: Attentional Certainty Modulates Ensemble-Induced Bias in Visualizations

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22885
作者: Jennifer E. Corbett,Brian W. Anthony
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Data visualizations often require viewers to extract both ensemble statistics and individual values from collections of graphical marks. Yet individual items embedded within an ensemble can be systematically biased by that context. Prior studies have reported both repulsion away from and attraction toward ensemble statistics, but these effects have been observed across different conditions. We test whether task or attentional certainty explains these opposing forms of ensemble-induced bias. In Study 1, observers briefly viewed ensembles of differently sized circles and then judged the size of an individual circle embedded within the ensemble. Using a common stimulus generation framework, we tested both identification and discrimination when the target was specified before or after the ensemble, and an additional no-cue identification condition without a specified target. Under the shared cued conditions, effects were predominantly repulsive or near zero in both identification and discrimination. In contrast, eliminating target-specific information reversed ensemble-induced bias from repulsion to attraction. Identification precision also decreased systematically from pre-cue to post-cue to no-cue conditions. Study 2 replicated this cue-dependent pattern in graphical displays of startup valuations and precinct vote contributions. Our findings isolate attentional certainty as a key determinant of whether ensemble context repels or attracts individual-item representations, extending the design question beyond precision to how attention directing choices determine which bias the viewer will be operating under.

作者: Osnat Mokryn,Oshrat Ayalon,Noga Dines,Orit Shaer
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Designers increasingly use large language models to simulate stakeholder conversations. Yet it remains unclear how AI-Simulated Stakeholders (AIS) are taken up when used alongside human stakeholder engagement. We report a field study in a single-institution, single-semester design course in which 8 teams (N=21) constructed, evaluated, and peer-reviewed an initial AIS. Then, the teams interviewed both AIS and human stakeholders in two sequences: AIS-first or human-first. Drawing on interview transcripts, design artifacts, course-embedded reflections, and post-course qualitative sessions, we examine exploratory patterns associated with these sequencing conditions. We find that students did not describe AIS as a neutral addition to the process. Instead, the order in which AIS and human stakeholders were formally interviewed was associated with different ways of interpreting and using information from the two sources. When the AIS interview came first, it provided a broad but often general frame that students later reconsidered through human interviews. When the AIS interview followed human engagement, AIS was more often used to revisit and validate insights already grounded in lived experience. Students described AIS as an “anchor,” but its reported role varied with its position in the formal interview sequence. In the final designs, a larger proportion of prominent human-stakeholder-derived concerns than AIS-derived concerns had corresponding design elements. We contribute: characterization of AIS as a reference point whose reported role varies with its position in the formal interview sequence; exploratory empirical evidence that the implemented interview-order conditions were associated with distinct patterns of interpreting and using stakeholder input; and implications for integrating AIS into design workflows in ways that preserve direct engagement with human stakeholders

作者: Uday Nath Gunda,Arun Raman,Parthasarathy PD
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Refreshable tactile displays can make graphics accessible to blind and low-vision people, but high-resolution actuator arrays remain expensive. We study whether a low-cost vibrotactile surface can convey simple figures, and how they are read. Nine participants (four blind; five sighted, tested blindfolded then open-eyed) identified seven figures by touch, with video and timing analysis of their exploration. Blind and blindfolded-sighted readers achieved comparable accuracy, but blind participants were about three times faster, using a continuous, rhythmic “gliding” strategy-reading through motion, whereas sighted participants searched in halting, pause-heavy passes; among the sighted, more pausing accompanied errors. Recognition failures were concentrated in specific figures (a diagonal was misread even with vision), locating the bottleneck in representation rather than resolution. We contribute an empirical characterization of tactile reading strategies and design implications for low-cost refreshable tactile displays and affordable tactile representation.

[HC-7] Controlling Proactive Multimodal AI: Separating Perception from Participation

作者: Muawiz Feroze Khan,Fatima Ali,Yun Huang
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 30 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Proactive multimodal AI can watch a user’s screen, listen to speech, track interaction, and decide whether to enter unfolding work. Little is known about how people want to control what such AI may perceive and how far it may participate. Informed by a 14-person Wizard-of-Oz study, we built SpotMe, a design probe that senses screen, speech, and interaction; chooses Silence, Ask, or Assist; and lets users separately configure what it may perceive, how far it may participate, and what types of support it may provide. In a 16-person study on a civic dashboard, participants first experienced proactive help, then inspected decisions to act or remain silent, and then configured SpotMe’s perception and participation. We found that participants could keep all perception channels available while lowering participation to Ask or Silence; that exposing suppressed decisions made silence interpretable and contestable; and that seeing what SpotMe used led some to change how they clicked, highlighted, and spoke. We contribute an empirical account of inspecting and controlling proactive multimodal AI by decoupling perception from participation.

[HC-8] Plenty to FRET About: From Hazard Analysis to Formal Requirements for Robot-Assisted Dressing

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22399
作者: Gunjari Chakraborty(University of Manchester),Yasmin Rafiq(University of Manchester),Hazel M. Taylor(University of Manchester),Marie Farrell(University of Manchester)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding requirements for systems involving humans and robots is essential for providing robust evidence that such systems behave correctly. Requirements formalisation approaches such as the Formal Requirements Elicitation Tool (FRET) can support the transition from unstructured natural language to formal representations suitable for verification. In this paper, we formalise 146 hazard-derived natural-language requirements for a Robot-Assisted Dressing (RAD) case study, previously classified using a taxonomy of Human-Robot Teamwork (HRT) requirements. Through an iterative process involving domain-expert clarification, these were represented by 117 unique FRETISH requirements. Formalisation exposed ambiguities, temporal and probabilistic assumptions, and cases where source requirements needed to be decomposed or could be consolidated because they expressed the same formal behaviour. Temporal analysis showed that 70.1% of the unique FRETISH requirements use either immediate-response or ordering constraints (immediately or before), while formalisation also exposed relationships between requirements across HRT taxonomy categories. We further analyse the formal semantics and realisability of the resulting requirements. The results show that HRT classification and formalisation provide complementary views: the taxonomy captures the teamwork concern represented by a requirement, while FRETISH makes the required behaviour explicit. We report practical lessons and limitations of applying FRET to HRT requirements and identify directions for further work.

Abstract:Smart buildings generate streams of operational data, yet this richness rarely translates into accessible, decision-ready information for stakeholders who inhabit and manage them. Current Building Digital Twin Systems (BDTS) often remain oriented toward technical specialists and rely on static, one-size-fits-all interfaces. This paper presents the design, implementation, and comparative user evaluation of an AI-driven conversational assistant integrated into a human-centric BDTS for Indoor Environmental Quality monitoring, combined with adaptive information presentation and auto-suggest functionality. The prototype was deployed at New York University Abu Dhabi. A controlled, two-arm, between-subjects, quasi-experimental study with wave-based, non-randomized assignment compared the Baseline interface with the Experimental interface. Results showed significant reductions in task-completion time and perceived workload, while accuracy and usability improved but did not meet the adjusted significance criterion. The study contributes an implemented and empirically evaluated architecture that separates generative interaction from deterministic environmental assessment and coordinates conversational responses with adaptive visual presentation.

[HC-10] Big Brains Tiny Board: Pupavision an Agent ic Physical AI Instrument for Monitoring Drosophila Pupariation and Lifecycle Transitions

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22136
作者: Joel Sadler,Daniel Graham,Melanie Worley
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 6 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many biology experiments are limited by the availability and ease of use of instruments that monitor and record them. For example, the timing of pupariation in the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster, a widely used model organism, can provide biologically relevant information about growth regulation and is often recorded manually. Here, we present Pupavision, a small physical AI instrument built from a single-board Linux computer and a day/night camera for roughly 45 to 75 US dollars in parts. The key idea is that a frontier coding agent runs its agentic harness directly on the tiny board. The model thinks in the cloud, but the agent works on the device. The agent assists image capture, writes code to repair errors, and checks the experiment every day to keep raw data capture reliable. If recording stops, the researcher gets a ping on their mobile phone. A simple deterministic capture service records one image every ten minutes and never depends on the agent. We report a 26-day pilot in a fly incubator (about 3,580 frames), including eleven days in which the agent was logged out and capture continued, and a 51-hour outage whose cause led to the layered design. A researcher-in-the-loop workflow then produces per-vial pupariation curves by tracing selected pupae backward in time from a late reference frame. Future work will validate the assay for lifecycle tracking accuracy against expert-labeled data and expand real-time computer vision analysis. Pupavision offers a blueprint for do-it-yourself agentic instruments that put frontier intelligence on a tiny board, with deterministic code underneath. We present this as an early case study from a pilot lab deployment and contribute lessons learned toward a future where scientific domain experts are empowered by DIY agentic hardware.

Abstract:Before attempting a bouldering problem, climbers inspect the route to find its holds and plan their moves, which novices find difficult on walls where many routes overlap. We built a projector-camera system that projects route cues onto the wall and compared three cues: circles on the route holds, limb-colored lines connecting the holds, and both combined. Ninety-six participants, 61 of them first-time climbers, each climbed four routes, one per cue and one without projection, in a Latin-square order. In mixed-effects models, all three cues shortened the time before the first attempt; with circles, its geometric mean fell from 83 s to 39 s. Circles also increased the number of moves made within each trial. Lines led to more use of off-route holds than circles, mainly on routes where such holds lay under the projected lines. Participants preferred the combined cue, although no behavioral advantage of it over circles was detected.

作者: Adi Krishnamoorthy,X.Y. Han

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon’s SQID and Wayfair’s WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.

Abstract:High-quality annotated datasets are critical for advancing computational social science (CSS) research, yet collecting, curating, and analyzing large-scale data from dynamic sources such as online social networks (OSNs) remains a persistent bottleneck. Researchers must also translate substantive questions into queries, relevance criteria, and defensible interpretations. Large language models (LLMs) can assist, but they can also obscure the judgments, potentially reducing researcher oversight and critical evaluation. We present AI4OSN, a mixed-initiative platform that keeps researchers in control of data collection, relevance labeling, and sensemaking while making AI assistance available as an inspectable advisory resource. In a systematic user study (N=18) using X/Twitter data, participants reported above-benchmark perceived usability (mean SUS score of 79.7), increased confidence in LLM-assisted annotation and analysis tasks, and low cognitive workload during AI-supported sensemaking. Notably, novice participants showed descriptively greater alignment and higher reported agreement with AI output than experienced participants, underscoring the need to support differentiated verification practices across expertise levels. Overall, this work contributes both a human-centered system for social data analysis and empirical insights into how AI-assisted interfaces shape researcher behavior, trust, and decision-making. Our findings highlight design opportunities and tensions in building accessible, transparent, and agentic AI systems for social media and web research.

[HC-14] Synchrony Affect and Perceived Autonomy in Virtual Robot-Facilitated Anxiety Support Groups

作者: A’di Dust,Mohammad Soleymani,Mina Kian,Maja Matarić

Abstract:Socially assistive robots could expand access to group-based mental health support when skilled human facilitators are unavailable. However, their effectiveness will depend on whether they foster productive interactions among participants. We examined dyadic head-movement synchrony among 96 participants across 18 virtual robot-facilitated anxiety support group sessions. A human-controlled virtual robot, via a Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) system, facilitated all sessions. We found that stronger peak synchrony predicted lower post-session negative affect. In contrast, speakers who more often followed listeners’ movements reported higher negative affect and state anxiety, demonstrating that synchrony strength and direction capture distinct interpersonal processes. Participants who believed the robot was autonomous showed more genuine synchrony and stronger peaks than those who believed it was human-operated; more negative attitudes toward robots also predicted greater synchrony. These findings support synchrony as an objective, behaviorally grounded measure for evaluating robot-facilitated groups and a potential signal for guiding future autonomous facilitators.

[HC-15] Its My Turn! Interpretable Methods Reveal Developmental Differences from Mother-Child Conversational Dynamics

作者: A’di Dust,Anura Deshpande,Pat Levitt,Maja Matarić
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 9 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding conversational interactions between mothers and children is an important challenge for computational behavioral modeling. Existing methods use traditional statistical approaches and subjective measures of conversational dynamics, without incorporating temporal or probabilistic modeling. We developed an interpretable computational framework that combines sequence analysis, information-theoretic measures, and Bayesian hierarchical modeling to characterize temporal conversational dynamics in parent-child play. We applied this framework to interactions from 94 mother-child dyads with two-year-old children. Sequence analysis revealed that dyads with lower language development (as defined by scores on the Bayley developmental test) exhibited more heterogeneous conversational organization and fewer serve-and-return exchanges than higher-development dyads, a reciprocal turn-taking pattern in which one partner initiates communication and the other responds. Mutual information analyses suggested differences in conversational predictability between lower- and higher-development dyads, although the bootstrap confidence intervals overlapped. Bayesian hierarchical models estimated temporal trajectories for maternal consecutive turns, child responses following maternal speech, and overlapping responses; HDIs showed that trajectories differed in whether they excluded 0, but there were no statistically credible differences between the Bayley groups. Overall, these results indicate that children with higher developmental scores have more organized and predictable communication styles, with more ``serve-and-return" patterns with their mothers. These results demonstrate that interpretable computational representations of conversational dynamics capture developmental differences beyond simple measures of speech quantity.

[HC-16] SimAI: Mechanistic User Simulation through Psychological Network Models

Abstract:Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. However, existing simulators largely overlook the psychological mechanisms that drive user behavior. We introduce SimAI, a framework for mechanistic user simulation that models how psychological factors interact to shape user responses. To overcome the challenge of supervising open-ended behavior, we propose a graph reconstruction objective that provides graph-level rewards based on how well simulated conversations reflect the underlying psychological relationships. To support this approach, we construct PSYCHE, a dataset of 18,576 profile-network pairs derived from 516 psychotherapy cases. Automatic evaluations show that SimAI achieves greater simulation and behavioral diversity than existing patient simulators while maintaining strong profile alignment. In an interactive study with 30 mental-health professionals and trainees, SimAI receives the highest average ratings for conversational authenticity, realistic help-seeking behavior, and clinical training utility. Beyond simulation quality, SimAI enables realistic clinical training and uncovers safety failures in prolonged AI interactions with vulnerable users. Code is available at this https URL.

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21642
作者: Xiaosong Wang,Ran Liu,Yifan Feng
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 7 pages, The 23rd IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Intelligence and Computing

Abstract:Vibrotactile feedback is often used to simulate material properties on interactive surfaces, but less is known about how it can help users interpret visual differences during touchscreen exploration. We present RelicTouch, a finger-worn system that converts image-derived features into movement-contingent vibration. Study 1 was a controlled within-subject experiment (n=20) examining how vibration intensity, stripe spacing, and finger configuration affected haptic–visual congruence and subjective clarity. Study 2 was an exploratory qualitative study with eight domain experts examining how users interpreted cues generated from luminance and edge variation during continuous image exploration. Results suggest that cue legibility was associated with distinguishable signal changes, movement-based comparison, and visual or task context. Abstract:Deployed LLMs field hundreds of millions of conversations a day and refuse a non-trivial fraction of user requests, yet the user-side cost of refusal, whether users disengage and by how much, is unmeasured on any production model: a blind spot for the consumer-facing platforms built on them. Abstract:This study explores the governance tensions among Google, OpenAI, Meta, and Microsoft, focusing on how competitive AI development can lead to the ethics suppression. The study aims to examine how ethical oversight loses practical influence even when responsible AI structures are formally in place, especially during rapid technological competition. Despite the rapid growth of responsible AI frameworks and ethical principles in the tech sector, there has been less focus on how these concerns are actually applied when pressure to deploy increases. This paper introduces the concept of ethics suppression in AI development, highlighting that while ethical oversight may exist on paper, its practical authority can diminish during decision-making. Using a comparative qualitative case study examining corporate governance documents, public statements, and reports on governance issues, we identify common issues such as reduced authority, a weakened ability to escalate concerns, urgency in deployment, and fragmented governance. Our findings indicate that heightened competition can weaken the influence of ethical oversight, even in organisations with established responsible AI practices. By differentiating ethics suppression from ethics washing, it offers a framework for organisations and policymakers to evaluate the effectiveness of ethical oversight in competitive AI development.

作者: Rui Ning,Om Chabra,Hari Balakrishnan

Abstract:Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer’s state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of 6.6\times over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.

Abstract:Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. Abstract:Histopathological analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) plays a critical role in cancer diagnosis, and multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely adopted for WSI analysis under weak supervision. This presents a class-incremental learning challenge, where models must acquire new classes with limited access to historical training data and recognize all learned classes without task identifiers at inference. A major obstacle is forgetting, as updates to feature aggregation and prediction modules can degrade performance on previously learned classes. Abstract:Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Abstract:We present a provably distortion-free semantic watermarking algorithm that requires only black-box sampling access to a generative model and black-box access to a semantic embedding. A watermark is called distortion-free if, averaged over its secret detection key, it leaves the generator’s output distribution unchanged; this provides a formal guarantee that watermarking does not reduce output quality. Conventional such watermarks are often brittle to transformations. This is especially problematic for images, where benign operations such as compression, cropping, or resizing change the entire pixel representation. Semantic watermarks therefore require detection to be robust to content-preserving transformations. Previous methods combining these properties rely heavily on specific white-box properties of the underlying model: either to autoregressive text generation or to diffusion-specific access, such as control of the initial noise or diffusion inversion. In contrast, our construction is fully generic: It only interacts with the generative model and the semantic embedding, a function that determines the notion of “preserving content” under which detection should be robust, via sample and query access. We then instantiate this framework for image generation. We characterize the two competing properties required of the semantic embedding: it should remain stable under transformations that preserve an image’s content, but should distinguish independent generations from the same prompt. We train an image encoder directly for this tradeoff. The resulting encoder improves separation while maintaining stability over off-the-shelf alternatives and enables strong aggregate detection while remaining robust to various transformations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our watermark scheme on both open-source and closed models, which is possible only due to restriction to black-box access.

Abstract:Abstracting structured buildings from limited observations is essential for 3D urban modeling and digital twins. Abstract:Photographic color grading shapes the tone and color of a photograph to achieve a desired look. These differences make it difficult to compare how faithfully the methods reproduce the same look. To compare methods under a shared protocol, we introduce LUTBench. Abstract:Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low power consumption, making them promising for speech-related applications. 作者: Ammar Ali

Abstract:Learned lossless codecs make smaller files than common classical codecs, yet the images we archive and train on still use classical codecs. A main reason is time: a learned codec takes seconds to decode a photo that a classical codec opens in milliseconds, and their faster variants give up most of their gain in size. We argue that much of this time is spent waiting, not computing: the network waits for the values it conditions on, and the arithmetic decoder reads them one at a time. We introduce FMT (Fixed-step Multiscale Tree), a lossless image format whose decoding order and entropy coder are designed together so that neither wait grows with the image. FMT stores an image as a coarse-to-fine tree whose steps hold independent values: a GPU predicts each step at once and decodes it in parallel rANS lanes that carry their states from step to step, so an image of any size decodes in a fixed number of sequential steps. On this tree we build a family of bit-exact codecs, from a rule with no network to large networks, and no codec we ran on the same GPU beats any of them on both size and speed. Without a network, FMT beats NVIDIA’s HTJ2K on size and speed; with a large one, it decodes Kodak photos 9 to 61X faster than learned codecs we ran on the same A100, at the same size or smaller.

Abstract:Audio-visual question answering on lightweight user devices requires balancing speed, memory usage, privacy, and communication. Abstract:Large-scale robotic simulation requires diverse deformable objects with executable physical properties and realistic interaction behaviors. Abstract:Long-video question answering benchmarks like Video-MME-v2 typically evaluate systems under a uniform frame budget for every question, despite stark variation in the evidence each query actually demands. Abstract:3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction. Abstract:Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision.
